jobs.title: Senior Director, GTM People Business Partner
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is hiring a Senior Director, GTM People Business Partner to be the senior people leader for our global go-to-market organization. Reporting to our Chief People Officer, you will sit on the Chief Revenue Officer’s leadership team and partner with the leaders of Direct Sales, Sales Engineering, Sales and Business Development, Channels, Revenue Operations and Enablement across the Americas, EMEA and APJ.

This is a builder’s role at a pivotal moment. Kong’s Series E is funding global go-to-market expansion, our field teams are growing across more than a dozen countries, and our sales motion is moving from API management to AI connectivity. You will shape how the revenue organization is designed, led, paid and grown, and lead the People Business Partners who support it.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the CRO and GTM leadership. Be the people voice on the CRO’s staff: org, talent, leadership and culture counsel, and the translation of each year’s revenue plan into a people plan.

  • Design the GTM organization for its next stage. Lead coverage-model changes, spans and layers, regional structures, and role architecture and leveling for sales, solutions engineering, SDR/BDR, partner and enablement roles, including new AI-connectivity selling roles.

  • Run headcount and capacity planning. With Finance, Revenue Operations and Talent Acquisition, build the ramp-adjusted capacity model, sequence hiring by territory and start date, and run a monthly GTM hiring review.

  • Govern sales compensation. With Global GTM Compensation and Total Rewards, shape plan philosophy, OTE and pay-mix benchmarks, quota-setting fairness, rollout, exceptions and disputes.

  • Build the GTM performance system. Run quarterly talent and attainment reviews, calibration, promotion criteria and fair, fast performance management across US, EMEA and APJ employment law.

  • Build the sales leadership bench. Assess first- and second-line leaders, own succession plans for the CRO’s leadership team, coach senior leaders, and launch a front-line sales manager program with Sales Enablement.

  • Shorten ramp and keep top performers. Define 30/60/90 plans with Enablement and Talent Acquisition, track time to quota, find the causes of early attrition and run targeted retention plans.

  • Protect culture, inclusion and engagement in the field. Own the GTM engagement read and the actions that follow, manager effectiveness, belonging and the norms of a distributed team.

  • Own employee relations and people risk for GTM. Lead investigations, restructures and international employment compliance across more than a dozen countries, with Legal and regional People leads.

  • Bring the data. Build the GTM people dashboard (attrition, ramp, attainment distribution, span of control, hiring velocity, representation) and present it at every QBR.

  • Lead the people side of change. Territory realignments, comp-plan changes, reorganizations, acquisition integrations and the field’s shift to AI connectivity.

  • Lead the GTM People Business Partner team and help shape Kong’s People operating model, including how AI and automation change HR work.


What You’ll Bring:

• 12+ years in People, including 5+ years as the lead business partner to a CRO, Chief Sales Officer or SVP of Sales at a B2B software company that at least doubled revenue during your

tenure.

• A background in infrastructure, developer-platform, API, cloud or open-source software. You know how technical sellers, solutions engineers and channel teams work, and how an open-source funnel feeds enterprise sales.

• Experience designing sales organizations with Finance and Revenue Operations: coverage models, spans and layers, role architecture, leveling and ramp-adjusted capacity plans.

• Fluency in sales compensation: OTE and pay-mix benchmarking, quota setting, accelerators and SPIFs, plan rollout, exceptions and disputes, and plans for usage-based products.

• A track record running performance management and talent reviews for quota-carrying teams in the US and in EMEA or APJ, including exits and restructures under different employment laws.

• Experience assessing and developing sales leaders, building succession plans for a revenue leadership team and coaching VP-level executives.

• Data fluency: you build and defend a people dashboard and bring analysis, not anecdotes, to a CRO staff meeting.

• Executive presence and judgment that a CRO and a CPO both trust, with speed and discretion on sensitive issues.

• Based in Southern California, or able to spend regular time in person with GTM leadership, with travel to San Francisco and the field.

 

How You’ll Work:

You are in the room before the decision, not after it. You say what the data says,

including to the CRO, and you leave managers more capable than you found them.

 

Nice to Have:

• You have been through a platform-to-AI shift in a company’s sales motion.

• You have integrated an acquired team into a sales organization.

• You have worked in a People function that uses AI and automation in recruiting and operations.

• You have partnered Customer Success and Business Development as well as direct sales.

• You have built or led a team of People Business Partners.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

• Experience assessing and developing sales leaders, building succession plans for a revenue leadership team and coaching VP-level executives.

• Data fluency: you build and defend a people dashboard and bring analysis, not anecdotes, to a CRO staff meeting.

• Executive presence and judgment that a CRO and a CPO both trust, with speed and discretion on sensitive issues.

• Based in Southern California, or able to spend regular time in person with GTM leadership, with travel to San Francisco and the field.

 


HOW YOU’LL WORK:

You are in the room before the decision, not after it. You say what the data says,

including to the CRO, and you leave managers more capable than you found them.

• You have been through a platform-to-AI shift in a company’s sales motion.

• You have integrated an acquired team into a sales organization.

• You have worked in a People function that uses AI and automation in recruiting and operations.

• You have partnered Customer Success and Business Development as well as direct sales.

• You have built or led a team of People Business Partners.

jobs.title: Developer Advocate - Volcano
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Volcano (volcano.dev) is a cloud for apps built with coding agents. You tell Claude Code, Cursor or Codex what you want, and it sets up the database, auth, functions, storage, realtime and deploys on Volcano without a trip through a dashboard. Most platforms were designed around a person in a console and added agent support later. We started from the agent.

We're a small team and launched publicly in September 2026. Volcano is incubated by Kong and runs as its own company with its own brand.

This role sits between engineering and the developers we build for. You'll build on Volcano constantly, show people what it can do, and bring back what you learn so the product gets better.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the Volcano Cookbook: recipes that build real apps on Volcano with tools developers already use, written up with the code, the decisions and the gotchas.

  • Build templates and examples people can deploy in one step.

  • Make video, including YouTube, streams and short demos.

  • Run Volcano hackathons, show up at others, and decide which sponsorships are worth doing.

  • Work with the companies whose tools appear in our recipes on joint content.

  • Spend time where developers ask questions, in Discord, on X and on GitHub, and bring what you hear back to the team.

  • Build the tooling and workflows that let a small team publish more without the quality slipping.

  • Be customer zero. You'll hit rough edges before users do, and engineers should be able to act on your reports.

Who You'll Bring:

  • You've built things in public in the last year and can show us what you shipped and how you told people about it.

  • You've done 0-to-1 work: started a company, joined one early, or launched something from nothing.

  • You're technical and fluent with coding agents. You don't need to be a database or infrastructure expert, but you can build a working app with Claude Code or similar, debug it when it breaks, and explain what happened.

  • You write well. You use AI in your own workflow, and you can tell when output reads like slop.

  • You like explaining things, whether to a room, a camera or a thread of skeptical replies.

  • Engineers trust you on technical accuracy.

Bonus Points:

  • An existing developer audience

  • Hackathon organizing experience

  • Experience with developer platforms like Vercel, Supabase, Neon or Cloudflare.

#LI-BR2

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, AI Governance (EMEA)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Product Marketing Manager, AI Governance (EMEA)

Location: EMEA

About the Role:

Kong is building the connectivity layer for the AI era — securing, governing, and monetizing every LLM, MCP, agent, and API request in production.

As the Product Marketing Manager for our AI portfolio, you'll be the commercial engine behind the fastest-moving part of our business. Working alongside a team of deeply technical product marketers who own positioning for AI traffic management, agent identity, and AI observability, you'll plan the launches, campaigns, and content that drive pipeline.

This is a high-leverage execution role. You'll own launches, content, and campaign execution across the entire AI portfolio, serving as the single interface between AI R&D and the demand generation, field marketing, and sales teams that bring our story to market.

What You'll Do:

  • Own launch execution across the AI portfolio — Manage the launch calendar, tiering framework, and cross-functional launch process for all AI product releases, coordinating inputs from technical PMM specialists into cohesive go-to-market moments.

  • Drive campaign strategy and content — Partner with demand generation and field marketing to build campaign briefs, messaging frameworks, and content assets (web copy, ebooks, webinars, videos) that translate technical differentiation into buyer-relevant narratives.

  • Serve as the commercial interface layer — Act as the single point of contact between the AI product marketing team and downstream marketing and sales functions, ensuring consistent messaging across every AI offering.

  • Support field and partner enablement — Collaborate with the revenue enablement team to deliver launch-aligned sales assets, talk tracks, and competitive positioning for the AI portfolio.

  • Coordinate with event marketing — Drive AI portfolio presence at flagship events, including product announcements, session content, and booth messaging.

  • Measure and iterate — Track launch and campaign performance, gather field feedback, and continuously refine messaging and asset strategy based on what moves pipeline.

What You'll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, or solutions engineering — ideally at an AI/ML platform company.

  • A genuine, hands-on interest in AI infrastructure. You follow developments in LLM deployment, agentic frameworks, the Model Context Protocol, and AI governance, and can speak credibly to AI platform engineers without bluffing.

  • A proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into crisp narratives that land with both technical practitioners and C-suite buyers.

  • A track record of developing product launches, sales enablement materials, and competitive intelligence programs that move pipeline and accelerate deals.

  • Highly collaborative — you thrive working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams.

  • Comfortable owning a stage: keynote presentations, analyst briefings, customer roundtables, and demo-heavy sessions energize you rather than intimidate you.

  • Experience in open-source software, SaaS platforms, and enterprise go-to-market motions is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with the AI connectivity landscape — including awareness of competing and complementary vendors across API gateways, AI observability, vector databases, iPaaS, and agentic orchestration frameworks — is a strong plus.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Kong’s growing Professional Services organization. This is a highly strategic, customer-facing engineering role focused on helping enterprise customers accelerate adoption of Kong’s API and AI Connectivity platform through hands-on implementation, automation, migration tooling, and solution engineering.

As an FDE, you will work directly alongside customer engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, accelerate migrations, build reusable automation, and deliver production-grade solutions in real-world enterprise environments. You will operate at the intersection of software engineering, architecture, platform engineering, and customer delivery.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building, coding, solving ambiguous problems, and working directly with customers on mission-critical initiatives involving APIs, AI gateways, service connectivity, modernization, and cloud-native platforms.

You will collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers, Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure successful customer outcomes while also influencing Kong’s product direction based on field experience.

Working at Kong is a unique opportunity to make a massive impact on Fortune 50/500 customers as they modernize mission-critical systems for the AI era.

 

What’s in it for you?

Impact

Work directly with some of the world’s largest enterprises to modernize API infrastructure and accelerate AI adoption through Kong’s connectivity platform.

Growth

Accelerate your technical and professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, AI connectivity, automation frameworks, and large-scale enterprise architectures.

Opportunity

Be part of a rapidly growing Professional Services organization that is shaping how enterprises adopt APIs, AI gateways, and modern connectivity platforms globally.

 
 

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner directly with enterprise customers to design, build, and implement Kong-based solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premise environments.

  • Lead hands-on implementation efforts for API gateways, AI gateways, service mesh, developer portals, and related connectivity technologies.

  • Build automation frameworks, migration tooling, custom integrations, and reusable accelerators to simplify customer adoption and modernization efforts.

  • Drive migration initiatives from legacy API management platforms to Kong.

  • Work closely with customer developers, platform teams, architects, security teams, and executives to solve complex technical and operational challenges.

  • Develop production-grade code, scripts, plugins, CI/CD integrations, Kubernetes automation, and infrastructure tooling as part of customer engagements.

  • Collaborate with Kong Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on real-world customer feedback and implementation learnings.

  • Create reusable best practices, technical assets, reference architectures, documentation, and design patterns to scale delivery excellence across the organization.

  • Support strategic customer initiatives involving AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

 

What You’ll Bring:

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, platform engineering, professional services, site reliability engineering, or software engineering roles.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering and implementation experience.

  • Experience with API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure expertise.

  • Experience building automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling.

  • Strong proficiency in Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience with major cloud providers including AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Programming experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, or Lua.

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation tooling such as Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or GitOps frameworks.

  • Prior experience working in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is highly preferred.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Strong builder mindset with the ability to solve complex technical problems with minimal supervision.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments.

  • Passion for working directly with customers and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and executive audiences.

  • Highly organized with strong prioritization and execution skills.

  • Passion for innovation, modern infrastructure, APIs, AI, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Team-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Leading the investigation of complex technical puzzles and working collaboratively to understand and resolve customer issues via live troubleshooting calls and emails in an enterprise environment

  • Creating knowledge articles to compliment our documentation and enable customers to better understand product use cases

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The is a hybrid role is based in Bangalore.

About the Role:

At Kong, our Sales Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around Kong. Sales Development reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization. We view our Sales Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at Kong.

To aid in this endeavor, we invest heavily in the training and development of our team. This includes a 2-week long sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, and global virtual group trainings. By joining our team, you are making an investment in yourself that will accelerate the rest of your sales career.

Our SDRs gain an understanding of our product, community, who we sell to, why they care, and what makes us relevant. They learn how to generate a pipeline quickly and effectively as well as how to achieve a good discovery and qualification. The team is a crucial resource for sales teams across Kong to get great talent from. This helps us scale our teams, as well as ensure that we have a culture of meritocracy.

Being an SDR, is often a first step to jump-starting a career in sales. At Kong, we have a culture that celebrates diversity, fosters growth and enablement, and ensures that we provide our SDRs with the tools and the confidence that they need to grow their careers.

The SDR leadership team has a true understanding of where each SDR is at in their personal development process, and mentors and enables them to ensure that they have the means and opportunity to be considered for their next role. At Kong, we truly believe that if you want to earn your MBA in sales, this is the place to be. As a leadership team, we spend an exorbitant amount of time working in the trenches with our teams to help them fine hone their business and sales acumen and ramp them to productivity, success, and greater roles.

 

What You'll Do:

Market Opportunity - We are on a quest to build a $10b+ software company over the next few years and need YOUR help!

Why APIs Matter? APIs have been enabling innovation for decades!

Strong VC team, Series D, strong year over year revenue growth!

Technical Leadership - We are recognized as the leader in innovation in the connectivity space.

Marco, our CTO/co-founder - “We are the Cisco of L4 and L7” - CUBE Conversation, March 2021

We are the leading innovator in the connectivity space!

Amazing Team & Culture - Come be a "Konger" and find out what we mean.

Great Place to Work Certified in 2020 & 2021

Kong employees exemplify our culture at our 2022 Sales Kickoff

2022 Forbes Cloud 100 Honoree

Building Great Products - Learn why the world's largest companies love our tech!

Kong Named a Leader in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant

Over 250m+ downloads of our open source API gateway! Over 40k+ stars on Github between Kong API and Kong Insomnia!

What you'll be doing: Your First 90 Days

  • By the end of month 1, you will:

  • Have met your new team and had fun playing with some new tools

  • Become a part of the wider Kong family

  • Have had a successful sales boot camp training

  • Have a good understanding of what makes Kong’s product offerings so special

  • Understand how our Sales Development, Marketing and Account Executive teams all work together

  • By the end of month 2, you will:

  • Be comfortable talking to clients on the phone about Kong

  • Have worked with our Account Executive team on your first opportunity

  • Have shadowed a ton of calls and practiced several role-plays

  • Started delivering your ramp quota

  • By the end of month 3, you will:

  • Know our sales funnel inside and out, and feel confident to add value to our sales org

  • Show clear delivery of our sales methodologies

  • Provide insights to both our Sales Development and marketing organizations to help us continue to iterate and improve

  • Delivered against your ramp quota

  • Role Overview & Key Responsibilities:

  • Work with the Sales team to develop inbound and outbound campaigns from idea generation through to qualified call

  • Develop strong sales and product knowledge.

  • Interact with IT and business decision-makers via telephone, video, LinkedIn, and email

  • Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management

  • Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team

  • Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential

  • Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota

  • Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business.

  • Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

  • And any additional tasks required by the manager.

     

What You'll Bring:

  • 1 year or more of strong sales or customer-facing experience.

  • A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals.

  • A ‘hunter’ mentality - comfortable prospecting, cold-calling, and following up on incoming leads and a strong desire to win.

  • Ability and willingness to learn, react to and share lessons learned across the organisation.

  • Open to feedback and can apply to your daily workflow.

  • Outstanding communication skills including both phone and written communication as well as active listening.

  • An extraordinary character with an incredible drive for success, a high work ethic, curious by nature, and obsessed with smashing sales goals.

  • Validated time leadership skills and ability to work independently and through coaching.

  • Desire to work in a driven and fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about cutting-edge technology with the aptitude to learn new and exciting IT software products, as well as, understand business critical solutions quickly.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Benelux
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About The Role:

We are seeking a committed Enterprise Account Executive with a successful background in sales and account management, ideally within open source or similar enterprise software environments. In this role, you will be a key driver of our growth strategy, directly impacting the stability and expansion of our recurring revenue. This position is ideal for a sales professional who has experience in landing new clients, retaining existing customers, and driving account expansion for early-stage enterprise products in a dynamic, entrepreneurial setting.

What You’ll Do:

Develop and execute sales strategies to target enterprise customers, focusing on building and maintaining a robust pipeline that drives long-term growth.

  • Own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and initial outreach to contract negotiations and closing deals, while consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including product, marketing, and customer success, to ensure a seamless sales experience and alignment on customer needs.

  • Identify customer pain points and align our solutions to address these, delivering customized product demos and presentations tailored to their specific business needs.

  • Build and nurture relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers within target accounts, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

  • Lead account planning efforts by researching potential customers, understanding industry trends, and developing strategies to win new business and grow existing accounts.

  • Monitor and manage sales activities and results, accurately forecasting opportunities and keeping detailed records of interactions and progress in CRM systems.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market changes to position our product effectively and maintain a competitive edge.

  • Contribute to business growth initiatives, providing feedback to product and marketing teams to influence product development and go-to-market strategies.

  • Represent Kong with professionalism, acting as a brand ambassador at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise sales (>1k employees), with a proven track record of closing complex deals in a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment.

  • Demonstrated success in selling to large enterprises, particularly to senior-level executives and across multiple departments.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and present compelling solutions that drive business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of managing high-stakes conversations and building lasting relationships with stakeholders.

  • A results-driven mindset, with a passion for meeting and exceeding sales goals and revenue targets.

  • Experience working with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and leveraging data to forecast accurately and track sales metrics.

  • Knowledge of open-source software, APIs, or infrastructure software is highly advantageous.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, taking ownership of your sales territory and adapting to changing market dynamics.

  • Analytical and strategic thinking, with a knack for identifying business growth opportunities and devising plans to capitalize on them.

jobs.title: Account Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Kong is the API and AI gateway company powering the connections behind the world's most demanding digital businesses, and now, its AI agents. We're building the infrastructure layer that lets enterprises govern APIs, tokens, and autonomous agents with equal confidence.

Why Kong?

The Mission: We sit at the center of the shift from traditional API management to AI Gateway and token governance helping enterprises put guardrails around the agentic systems they're racing to deploy.

The Momentum: Category-defining product, enterprise logos, and a GTM engine built from the ground up for the AI era, not retrofitted onto one.

The DNA: We look for people who treat outbound as a craft, not a numbers game. Curious operators who want to run at the frontier of AI-led selling.

The Role:

AI hasn't just changed what we sell, it's changed how we sell it. As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Kong, you'll be one of the first voices prospects hear about the next generation of API and AI Agent management, and you'll do it using the same class of AI-native tooling and signal-based workflows we sell.

You won't be grinding through generic call lists. You'll operate inside a signal-based pipeline built on tools like Nooks, Octave, and ZoomInfo, surfacing accounts showing real buying intent (competitor churn signals, funding events, tech-stack shifts, hiring patterns) and turning that intelligence into sharp, personalized conversations.

What You'll Be Doing:

- Run signal-based prospecting across a defined set of intent categories competitive displacement, infrastructure investment, AI/agent initiatives, and more, rather than blanket outbound.

- Partner with Marketing and RevOps to build AI-assisted, auto-personalized outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

- Use AI-enabled prospecting and enrichment platforms to research accounts, tailor messaging, and multi-thread into CFO, CTO, and CISO personas.

- Qualify and convert inbound interest quickly, applying a modern qualification framework built for fast-moving AI buying cycles (tension, economic impact, buying mandate, proof, and optionality) rather than legacy checklist selling.

- Continuously test messaging, sequencing, and calling approaches, treating your pipeline like an experiment you're always optimizing.

- Build a point of view and public presence in the API/AI infrastructure space, becoming a trusted resource for prospects navigating this shift.

- Feed market and competitive intelligence back to GTM leadership to sharpen targeting and messaging over time.

- Deepen your product fluency by partnering closely with Sales and Product, especially on how enterprises are approaching AI Gateway and token governance.

Your pipeline directly fuels a company at the center of one of the biggest infrastructure shifts in software.

Essential Skills:

- 1-2+ years of SDR/ADR experience in high-growth B2B SaaS, ideally selling a technical or infrastructure product within the Public Sector.

- Genuine AI curiosity - you've used (or are eager to master) modern AI-native prospecting tools, not just traditional sequencers.

- Growth mindset - you treat skill as something built through reps, feedback, and iteration.

- Comfortable on the phone and unafraid of cold outreach; you track and improve your own conversion rate.

- Resilient and self-driven - rejection is data, not a verdict.

- Coachable - you actively seek feedback and adapt quickly to new plays and tooling.

Who Thrives Here:

You'll fit right in if you:

- Get energized by fast-moving AI and infrastructure markets.

- Want ownership over your process from signal to sequence to booked meeting.

- Value a culture of experimentation over rigid scripts.

- Care about the quality of every touch, not just the volume.

*Bonus points if you've got exposure to APIs, cloud-native platforms, or AI/agent tooling but curiosity and drive matter more than a specific resume line.

Life at Kong:

- Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) program

- Equity - you help build the category, you share in the upside

- Flexible PTO + company holidays

- Wellness and mental health support

- Learning and development budget

- Hybrid work model with regional hubs

- Regular team events and company offsites

Kong is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Counsel, Commercial (US East)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join as an early member of Kong’s commercial legal team, responsible for helping support Kong’s strategic sales growth in the Americas East region and provide support to the AMER team as it grows. In this role, you will be a trusted strategic partner to the Americas East revenue team. You will draft, structure and negotiate customer contracts with some of the world’s biggest brands in financial services, technology, e-commerce and other industries. You will also play a primary role in supporting our US federal government customers. You will be called on to assess legal and business risks, make sound decisions, and provide advice on a broad range of issues in areas such as privacy, security, open-source software and intellectual property, and assist with other issues as they come up. You will report to Kong’s Sr. Director, Head of Global Commercial Legal. The position is based in New York, Chicago, Austin TX, or Toronto.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Lead complex SaaS and on-premises commercial negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Kong’s Americas sales team, primarily in the US East market

  • Review, draft, and negotiate a wide variety of other commercial agreements

  • Help ensure compliance with a variety of laws and regulations impacting our SaaS and on-premises offerings, including regarding artificial intelligence, intellectual property, privacy, security and government contracting

  • Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations and Customer Assurance to support the end-to-end contract close process

  • Advise internal teams on legal matters and provide general commercial legal advice

  • Assisting with the development of our positions with respect to artificial intelligence and our products as they relate to our customers’ infrastructure.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Law degree, and member in good standing of the applicable state bar or eligible to be a registered in-house counsel

  • Minimum 7-10 years of experience practicing law both in private practice and in-house, preferably with late-stage private and/or early-stage public technology companies

  • Demonstrated experience in negotiating and closing complex SaaS and software contracts with large, sophisticated customers

  • Collaborative, and willing to build something together as a team

  • Experience with federal government procurement and customers

  • Great judgment, and an ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships within the company, with customers, and others

  • Working knowledge of intellectual property, data governance and information security/privacy matters

  • High professional and personal standards, and a commitment to inclusiveness

  • Attention to detail and an ability to view legal issues within the context of business objectives

 

Location:

  • Any of New York, Chicago, Austin TX or Toronto

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Management
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission:

At Kong, we are building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, govern, and scale their AI applications with speed and intelligence. As a Staff Product Manager for AI Management, you will own the product direction for our fastest-growing agentic AI portfolio—including our flagship AI Gateway—serving as a critical strategic lever in the Agentic Era. You will bridge high-impact technical innovation with enterprise runtime governance, context management, and developer platform experience to turn APIs and AI connectivity into an organizational innovation factory.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and execute the product vision and roadmap for AI Management modules, driving core capabilities around agentic harnesses, LLM routing, policies, context, guardrails, and evaluation.

  • Lead cross-departmental strategy as a multiplier across engineering, design, product marketing, and executive leadership to align shared roadmaps without operational friction.

  • Own the full lifecycle of your product modules by writing precise specs, prioritizing backlogs, and balancing new feature delivery against technical debt and platform dependencies.

  • Drive cross-product work connecting AI Management to Kong’s core platform infrastructure, enabling seamless data plane and control plane integration.

  • Speed up the clock on high-velocity delivery cadences in close partnership with engineering leads to scope work, navigate trade-offs, and accelerate time to market.

  • Support regional field activities, customer-facing technical engagements, and sales enablement to validate product-market fit and ensure developer delight.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7-10 years of technical product management experience owning and shipping technical products in developer tools, API platforms, or AI infrastructure.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical challenges—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, request routing, data plane architectures, and transport trade-offs—into actionable product requirements.

  • Proven track record driving execution and managing dependencies across globally distributed R&D teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to articulate technical strategy across multiple functions and seniority levels.

  • Deep project management instincts to track work, surface blockers early, and keep cross-functional roadmaps on schedule.

The Kong DNA:

  • Ownership: You act as a driver, not a passenger, holding yourself accountable for product outcomes, runtime performance, and customer success.

  • Urgency: You model speed and efficiency in everything you do, navigating the fast-paced pre-IPO landscape with grit and focus.

  • Collaboration: You lead like an API by working cross-functionally, breaking down silos, and building alignment across global teams.

Bonus Points:

  • Direct experience with agentic AI development, including AI agents, AI gateways, LLM routing, AI observability, prompt management, guardrails, MCP servers, and A2A communications.

  • Familiarity with enterprise platform engineering, Kubernetes, cloud-native architectures, control planes, and data planes.

jobs.title: Account Development Representative (German-speaking)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is The AI Connectivity Company. Our platform sits at the centre of how enterprises manage APIs, AI agents, and the infrastructure connecting them and we’re scaling fast. The ADR role is the front line of that growth. The accounts you open today are the expansion stories of tomorrow.

 

As a Commercial Outbound ADR, you’ll identify and qualify new business opportunities across the EMEA commercial segment, working closely with our Sales and Marketing teams. This isn’t just a job, it’s the best way to fast-track a long career in tech sales.

 

We invest heavily in our people: a 4-week sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, continuous training throughout your tenure, and a leadership team that actually gets in the trenches with you. If you want an MBA in sales, this is the place to earn it.

 

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1: Meet your team, complete bootcamp, and fall in love with what Kong actually does.

  • Month 2: Pick up the phone with confidence, master our tech stach (Nooks, Claude, Gemini, Sumble, Lusha etc) and work your first live opportunity, and hit your ramp quota.

  • Month 3: Own your funnel, share what’s working, and what needs optimisation.

     

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and run outbound campaigns end-to-end, from idea to qualified meeting

  • Engage decision-makers across phone, email, LinkedIn, and video

  • Partner closely with AEs and Marketing, you’re a connector, not just a top-of-funnel rep

  • Keep Salesforce clean and your pipeline tighter, process matters here

  • Utilise AI to boost productivity, work at pace and personalise your messaging

  • Invest in your own development, your manager will meet you where you are and help you get to what’s next

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Some experience in a customer-facing or sales role — internships, retail, or hospitality count if you can show you know how to build rapport and drive outcomes

  • A hunter mentality, you’re not waiting to be handed leads, you go and find them

  • High coachability, you take feedback well, apply it fast, and ask for more

  • Strong communicator, clear and confident in writing and on a call

  • Genuine curiosity about technology - you don’t need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what Kong does and why it matters

  • Languages: Fluency in German is essential.

Why Kong?

  • Be part of the company defining the future of AI connectivity. APIs and agents run on Kong

  • Real career development - our ADRs are the next wave of AEs in the tech, and our leadership team is invested in making that happen

  • Hybrid from our central London office - walking distance from Bank Station and London Bridge, 2–3 days a week in the office. A beautiful location to work from in Summer

  • Competitive comp, benefits, and a team that shows up with integrity, energy, and purpose

 

Every day, we raise the bar of what great looks like. Ready to help set it?

 

#LI-TR1

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced sales professional, ideally with open source experience who will be selling into global enterprise accounts. The ideal candidate has been a part of the sales efforts for other early-stage enterprise products in an entrepreneurial setting. The Enterprise Account Executive will be integral to our growth plan and in acquiring new customers. Kong’s Account Executive will be the primary point of contact and the face of Kong for our prospects.

The role provides an opportunity to have real impact in a company scaling within a high-growth market, plus uncapped commission and earnings potential.

 
 

What You'll Do:

  • Sell Kong Enterprise Platform to enterprise customers.

  • Meet individual quota and objectives.

  • Take ownership of your book of business, which includes understanding and documenting the buying criteria and process, determining the appropriate motion and patterns, ensuring pipeline accuracy based on evidence, and working the leads to closure.

  • Provide account leadership and direction in the pre- and post-sales process and contribute to analysis on wins/losses.

  • Ability to travel to customer sites as required (30% - 50%).

     

What You'll Bring:

  • A true desire to see customers benefit from the investment they make with Kong.

  • Proven experience in selling enterprise software; experience with open source, APIs, and/or infrastructure software strongly preferred

  • Ability to leverage established relationships and effective sales techniques for success.

  • Effective communicator and strong interpersonal skills.

  • Excellent negotiation, presentation and closing abilities.

  • Motivated, driven and results oriented mindset

  • Methodical approach to sales and pipeline generation

Bonus points:

  • Experience within a fast moving scale-up is preferable.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced sales professional, ideally with open source experience who will be selling into global enterprise accounts in Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate has been a part of the sales efforts for other early-stage enterprise products in an entrepreneurial setting. The Enterprise Account Executive will be integral to our growth plan and in acquiring new customers. Kong’s Account Executive will be the primary point of contact and the face of Kong for our prospects.

The role provides an opportunity to have real impact in a company scaling within a high-growth market plus uncapped commission and earnings potential.

Kong has the tech, the timing and the territory. Come and join our talented team!

 

What You'll Do:

  • Meet individual quota and objectives

  • Take ownership of your book of business, which includes understanding and documenting the buying criteria and process, determining the appropriate motion and patterns, ensuring pipeline accuracy based on evidence, and working the leads to closure

  • Provide account leadership and direction in the pre- and post-sales process and contribute to analysis on wins/losses

  • Ability to travel to customer sites as required

     

What You'll Bring:

  • A true desire to see customers benefit from the investment they make with Kong

  • Extensive regional experience selling to enterprise customers in Saudi Arabia

  • Proven experience selling enterprise software; experience with open source, APIs, and/or infrastructure software a big plus

  • Ability to leverage established relationships and employ proven sales techniques for success

  • Effective communicator and strong interpersonal skills

  • Excellent negotiation, presentation and closing skills

  • Motivated, driven and results oriented mindset

  • Structured approach to sales and pipeline generation

Bonus points:

  • Experience within a fast moving scale-up is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Team Lead, Account Development Representatives (Nordics & Benelux)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our Benelux, and Nordics regions. This is a player-coach role. You'll be taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing.

You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.

What You'll Do:

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. You'll help build individual development plans grounded in a real read of each rep's attitude, process, and results, and you'll flag underperformance early, with context, instead of letting it fester.

Coach and upskill the team. You'll support team coaching sessions: live dialling, pitch practice, feedback loops. You'll run or contribute to upskilling initiatives, on your own or with Enablement. You'll share what's working, best practices, sequences, outbound approaches, with the wider team, and give direct, specific feedback often, recognizing strong work and not letting bad habits slide.

Sharpen process and tooling. You'll help spot where the team's workflows and tooling could run more efficiently, and support the Senior Manager in rolling out improvements without stripping reps of their autonomy. You'll be the go-to person for best practice on Salesforce, Outreach, and the team's automation tools.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.

What You'll Bring:

  • Hands-on ADR or SDR experience. You know what this job feels like from the inside, not just what it looks like from a deck.

  • A real coach's instinct. You get energy from making other people better, not just from hitting your own number.

  • The ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball. Your own quota, coaching newer reps, and process work will all pull on your time in the same week, and you know how to decide what actually matters right now.

  • Strong time management. This is one we screen for directly, not something we assume comes with experience.

  • A bias for building. You spot what needs fixing and go build it, rather than working only through a list of tasks someone else handed you.

  • Analytical rigor. You make calls based on data, not gut feel, and you're comfortable being specific about why a number moved, including when that number is going the wrong way.

  • A track record of top-tier performance that holds up on both counts: the day-to-day discipline that drives it (activity, sequence execution, pipeline hygiene), and the results that discipline produces, quarter over quarter, not just once.

  • Real trust with your AE and RD partners, earned through consistency, not just alignment on paper.

  • Transparency, especially with leadership, especially when something isn't on track. We'd rather hear it early than find out later.

  • The kind of presence the team actually looks up to, not just reports to.

  • Comfort in an allbound model with a heavy outbound emphasis.

  • Self-awareness and a genuine investment in growing as a leader.

  • Language skills: English is a core requirements, with Dutch OR Swedish

Culture and Value:

The EMEA SDR team are weather makers. We don't wait for opportunity, we create it. We're accountable, relentless, and we invest in each other like no other team does.

  • Relentless. Energy and intention every day. Every challenge is a chance to get stronger.

  • Character. Good humans first. Integrity, humility, and keeping our word.

  • Together. No one gets left behind. Differences make us better, not harder to manage.

  • Truth. Radical honesty. We say the hard things with care. That's how we move fast.

  • Accountable. We own our results, bias toward action, and don't wait to be told.

  • Pioneering. We take up space, experiment, and bring creative thinking to every challenge.

In NEMEA specifically, we operate in mature markets. We don't manufacture urgency, we earn entry by knowing the landscape better than the prospect does. We're pipeline gardeners: patient, precise, persistent.

"We don't book meetings. We build pipeline."

This role is a genuine development opportunity. For the right person, it's the foundation of a leadership career at Kong.

jobs.title: Account Development Representative (Austin, TX) (Hybrid)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Kong is the API and AI gateway company powering the connections behind the world's most demanding digital businesses, and now, its AI agents. We're building the infrastructure layer that lets enterprises govern APIs, tokens, and autonomous agents with equal confidence.

Why Kong?

The Mission: We sit at the center of the shift from traditional API management to AI Gateway and token governance helping enterprises put guardrails around the agentic systems they're racing to deploy.

The Momentum: Category-defining product, enterprise logos, and a GTM engine built from the ground up for the AI era, not retrofitted onto one.

The DNA: We look for people who treat outbound as a craft, not a numbers game. Curious operators who want to run at the frontier of AI-led selling.

The Role:

AI hasn't just changed what we sell, it's changed how we sell it. As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Kong, you'll be one of the first voices prospects hear about the next generation of API and AI Agent management, and you'll do it using the same class of AI-native tooling and signal-based workflows we sell.

You won't be grinding through generic call lists. You'll operate inside a signal-based pipeline built on tools like Nooks, Octave, and ZoomInfo, surfacing accounts showing real buying intent (competitor churn signals, funding events, tech-stack shifts, hiring patterns) and turning that intelligence into sharp, personalized conversations.

What You'll Be Doing:

- Run signal-based prospecting across a defined set of intent categories competitive displacement, infrastructure investment, AI/agent initiatives, and more, rather than blanket outbound.

- Partner with Marketing and RevOps to build AI-assisted, auto-personalized outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

- Use AI-enabled prospecting and enrichment platforms to research accounts, tailor messaging, and multi-thread into CFO, CTO, and CISO personas.

- Qualify and convert inbound interest quickly, applying a modern qualification framework built for fast-moving AI buying cycles (tension, economic impact, buying mandate, proof, and optionality) rather than legacy checklist selling.

- Continuously test messaging, sequencing, and calling approaches, treating your pipeline like an experiment you're always optimizing.

- Build a point of view and public presence in the API/AI infrastructure space, becoming a trusted resource for prospects navigating this shift.

- Feed market and competitive intelligence back to GTM leadership to sharpen targeting and messaging over time.

- Deepen your product fluency by partnering closely with Sales and Product, especially on how enterprises are approaching AI Gateway and token governance.

Your pipeline directly fuels a company at the center of one of the biggest infrastructure shifts in software.

Essential Skills:

- 1-2+ years of SDR/ADR experience in high-growth B2B SaaS, ideally selling a technical or infrastructure product.

- Genuine AI curiosity - you've used (or are eager to master) modern AI-native prospecting tools, not just traditional sequencers.

- Growth mindset - you treat skill as something built through reps, feedback, and iteration.

- Comfortable on the phone and unafraid of cold outreach; you track and improve your own conversion rate.

- Resilient and self-driven - rejection is data, not a verdict.

- Coachable - you actively seek feedback and adapt quickly to new plays and tooling.

Who Thrives Here:

You'll fit right in if you:

- Get energized by fast-moving AI and infrastructure markets.

- Want ownership over your process from signal to sequence to booked meeting.

- Value a culture of experimentation over rigid scripts.

- Care about the quality of every touch, not just the volume.

*Bonus points if you've got exposure to APIs, cloud-native platforms, or AI/agent tooling but curiosity and drive matter more than a specific resume line.

Life at Kong:

- Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) program

- Equity - you help build the category, you share in the upside

- Flexible PTO + company holidays

- Wellness and mental health support

- Learning and development budget

- Hybrid work model with regional hubs

- Regular team events and company offsites

Kong is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

The Momentum: Category-defining product, enterprise logos, and a GTM engine built from the ground up for the AI era, not retrofitted onto one.



The DNA: We look for people who treat outbound as a craft, not a numbers game. Curious operators who want to run at the frontier of AI-led selling.



About the Role:



AI hasn't just changed what we sell, it's changed how we sell it. As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Kong, you'll be one of the first voices prospects hear about the next generation of API and AI Agent management, and you'll do it using the same class of AI-native tooling and signal-based workflows we sell.



You won't be grinding through generic call lists. You'll operate inside a signal-based pipeline built on tools like Nooks, Octave, and ZoomInfo, surfacing accounts showing real buying intent (competitor churn signals, funding events, tech-stack shifts, hiring patterns) and turning that intelligence into sharp, personalized conversations.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Run signal-based prospecting across a defined set of intent categories competitive displacement, infrastructure investment, AI/agent initiatives, and more, rather than blanket outbound.

- Partner with Marketing and RevOps to build AI-assisted, auto-personalized outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

- Use AI-enabled prospecting and enrichment platforms to research accounts, tailor messaging, and multi-thread into CFO, CTO, and CISO personas.

- Qualify and convert inbound interest quickly, applying a modern qualification framework built for fast-moving AI buying cycles (tension, economic impact, buying mandate, proof, and optionality) rather than legacy checklist selling.

- Continuously test messaging, sequencing, and calling approaches, treating your pipeline like an experiment you're always optimizing.

- Build a point of view and public presence in the API/AI infrastructure space, becoming a trusted resource for prospects navigating this shift.

- Feed market and competitive intelligence back to GTM leadership to sharpen targeting and messaging over time.

- Deepen your product fluency by partnering closely with Sales and Product, especially on how enterprises are approaching AI Gateway and token governance.



Your pipeline directly fuels a company at the center of one of the biggest infrastructure shifts in software.



Essential Skills:

- 1-2+ years of SDR/ADR experience in high-growth B2B SaaS, ideally selling a technical or infrastructure product.

- Genuine AI curiosity - you've used (or are eager to master) modern AI-native prospecting tools, not just traditional sequencers.

- Growth mindset - you treat skill as something built through reps, feedback, and iteration.

- Comfortable on the phone and unafraid of cold outreach; you track and improve your own conversion rate.

- Resilient and self-driven - rejection is data, not a verdict.

- Coachable - you actively seek feedback and adapt quickly to new plays and tooling.



Who Thrives Here:

You'll fit right in if you:

- Get energized by fast-moving AI and infrastructure markets.

- Want ownership over your process from signal to sequence to booked meeting.

- Value a culture of experimentation over rigid scripts.

- Care about the quality of every touch, not just the volume.



*Bonus points if you've got exposure to APIs, cloud-native platforms, or AI/agent tooling but curiosity and drive matter more than a specific resume line.



Life at Kong:

- Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) program

- Equity -  you help build the category, you share in the upside

- Flexible PTO + company holidays

- Wellness and mental health support

- Learning and development budget

- Hybrid work model with regional hubs

- Regular team events and company offsites



Kong is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Professional Services
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

AI traffic is about to outrun API traffic the same way API traffic outran human traffic. Come lead the team that gets enterprises through that transition.

If you don't think you meet every bullet below, apply anyway. Nobody checks every box — we're looking for people who are strong in a few areas and hungry in the rest.

About the Role:

Kong is the connectivity layer of AI. We're a 6-time Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader and a Forrester Wave Leader, running in production at Fortune 500 scale. Every enterprise moving from “we're piloting AI” to “AI is in production” runs into the same wall: governance, security, and connectivity for a traffic pattern nobody built for. That's the opportunity in front of this team, and it's why Professional Services is one of the fastest-growing parts of this company right now.

We're hiring a Professional Services Manager to lead a team of Field Engineers and Engagement Managers across Kong's US Professional Services organization. This is a leadership role, not a delivery role: you're directly responsible for delivery outcomes, staffing, and the growth of the people who sit hands-on with customer engineering teams every day.

You own the full engagement lifecycle for your book of business — staffing the right Field Engineers and Engagement Managers on every account, holding the team to go-live dates and technical quality, and driving resolution personally on the highest-risk or highest-value accounts. You're operating at the intersection of people leadership, technical delivery, and enterprise account management, and you're judged on outcomes, not activity.

We want leaders who've done the implementation work themselves and now want to multiply that impact through a team: coach the engineers, clear the blockers and build the delivery muscle that lets Kong keep pace with enterprise demand for API and AI connectivity.

You'll work daily with Solutions Architects, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Product Engineering — scoping engagements correctly before they land on your team, and feeding what you learn in the field straight back into how Kong builds and sells.

This is a rare seat: AI connectivity is a land grab right now, and the person who builds this team's delivery model in the next 18 months owns a track record that doesn't come around twice.

Impact

Lead the team that turns Kong's platform into production reality for some of the world's largest enterprises — the ones deciding right now how AI gets governed, secured, and scaled across their business.

Growth

Build your leadership craft against the fastest-moving category in enterprise software: AI connectivity, cloud-native architecture, and distributed systems at Fortune 500 scale. Prove out this team's model and the case for more scope writes itself.

Opportunity

Join a Professional Services organization growing as fast as the AI adoption curve it's built to serve — market-leading credibility behind every conversation you walk into, and a direct hand in building the delivery model while it's still being written.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage and grow a team of Field Engineers and Engagement Managers — hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

  • Own delivery outcomes across your book of business: go-live dates, technical quality, and customer satisfaction. Report on them with the same rigor you'd demand from your team.

  • Staff the right Field Engineer and Engagement Manager to every engagement based on account complexity, technical scope, and team capacity.

  • Be the senior escalation point on at-risk or high-complexity engagements — drive resolution and direct the team's response personally.

  • Run your team's operating cadence: staffing reviews, at-risk reviews, 1:1s, and status reporting up to Professional Services leadership.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Architecture to scope new engagements accurately and take clean handoffs from pre-sale to delivery.

  • Set and enforce delivery standards across your team — reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices that outlive any single engagement.

  • Feed what your team learns in the field back to Kong Product and Engineering — real customer signal shapes our roadmap.

  • Lead your team's work on the strategic initiatives that matter most right now: AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

What You'll Bring:

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, professional services, or platform engineering, including 2+ years directly managing a technical, customer-facing team.

  • A track record of delivery leadership in API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms — deep enough that you can direct and evaluate your team's work, not just review it.

  • Experience managing staffing, capacity, and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent enterprise engagements.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure fluency — enough to unblock your team and hold your own with customer architects and executives.

  • Experience with major cloud providers: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Comfort directing and evaluating automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling built by your team.

  • Prior experience in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is a strong plus.

Preferred Attributes

  • A decisive leadership mindset — you make the staffing and prioritization call and drive it to resolution without needing to do the work yourself.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments where the right call today beats the perfect call next week.

  • A genuine passion for growing engineers and engagement managers into their next role — this job is measured in the careers you build, not just the accounts you save.

  • Excellent communication across technical and executive audiences, internal and customer-facing.

  • Highly organized, with strong prioritization and execution across a multi-account portfolio.

  • Real enthusiasm for AI, modern infrastructure, and cloud-native technology — this team is living the shift, not reading about it.

  • A strong sense of ownership for outcomes that aren't always fully in your control — that's the job.

#LI-KH1

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing (Senior Staff)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission:

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

What You’ll Do:

  • Platform Vision: Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

  • Unified Entitlements: Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.

  • Pricing & Packaging Delivery: Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.

  • Metering & Usage Visibility: Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.

  • Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle: Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

  • Enterprise & Marketplace Motions: Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.

  • Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

  • Outcomes & Measurement: Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections aging, and billing support ticket load. Use them to set priorities and hold the team accountable for results.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Have at least 6 years of product management experience in SaaS, with 2 or more spent directly in a billing, monetization, or pricing domain.

  • Can reason about the moving parts of a billing stack well enough to co-design the architecture with your engineering partner.

  • Have carried a pricing or packaging change from proposal through to production, including financial modeling, plan configuration, grandfathering logic, migrations, sales enablement, and customer communication.

  • Have built or scaled consumption-based monetization and understand the tradeoffs between simplicity, accuracy, and customer trust when metering drives the invoice.

  • Pull your own numbers when you need them (SQL, Snowflake, Hex, or equivalent) and use data to set priorities rather than to decorate decisions already made.

  • Have worked directly with Stripe or a metered billing platform (Metronome, Orb, OpenMeter), not through an engineer.

  • Hold billing surfaces (plan pages, checkouts, invoices, usage dashboards) to the same design standard as the rest of the product.

  • Have worked in or adjacent to API, infrastructure, or developer-platform products, and are comfortable with the technical context that comes with that territory.
