THE MISSION:

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.



In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.



This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Platform Vision: Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

 - Unified Entitlements: Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.

 - Pricing & Packaging Delivery: Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.

 - Metering & Usage Visibility: Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.

 - Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle: Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

 - Enterprise & Marketplace Motions: Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.

 - Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

 - Outcomes & Measurement: Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections aging, and billing support ticket load. Use them to set priorities and hold the team accountable for results.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - Have at least 6 years of product management experience in SaaS, with 2 or more spent directly in a billing, monetization, or pricing domain.

 - Can reason about the moving parts of a billing stack well enough to co-design the architecture with your engineering partner.

 - Have carried a pricing or packaging change from proposal through to production, including financial modeling, plan configuration, grandfathering logic, migrations, sales enablement, and customer communication.

 - Have built or scaled consumption-based monetization and understand the tradeoffs between simplicity, accuracy, and customer trust when metering drives the invoice.

 - Pull your own numbers when you need them (SQL, Snowflake, Hex, or equivalent) and use data to set priorities rather than to decorate decisions already made.

 - Have worked directly with Stripe or a metered billing platform (Metronome, Orb, OpenMeter), not through an engineer.

 - Hold billing surfaces (plan pages, checkouts, invoices, usage dashboards) to the same design standard as the rest of the product.

 - Have worked in or adjacent to API, infrastructure, or developer-platform products, and are comfortable with the technical context that comes with that territory.

 - Independently define and execute the long-term vision to bring billing, fulfillment, and provisioning to best-in-class for the company's success.

 - Experience leading an end-to-end pricing transformation or building a billing system from scratch.

 - Shipped cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure) or Salesforce CPQ-to-billing integrations.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

You will be working at a dynamic and fast paced start-up as a member of the Customer Experience (CX) team. You will be enabling Customers to leverage APIs and microservices to drive their business initiatives in one of the most exciting and innovative technology domains in the industry. This team is responsible for interfacing with our customers throughout their lifecycle helping them realize the value of their Kong investment.

As a member of the CX team you will act as a champion for our most critical asset, our customers. You will be working with a portfolio of customers seeking to identify growth opportunities and ensuring they have what they need to be successful. In this role you will work alongside the Americas sales teams and will have the opportunity to build a large portfolio of Customers.

This is an incredibly exciting and challenging role at the forefront of technology, requiring someone with very strong organizational and communication skills. You will not only be building strong relationships with key customers, you will be pioneering the approach to managing customers by leveraging self service technology and re-usable assets to maximize the value Kong can provide.

Working at Kong presents a unique opportunity to help to modernize enterprise software and learn about how businesses run in the digital age.

Above all you’ll be acting as a stellar teammate for the rest of Kong.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Coaching our customers throughout their lifecycle while working collaboratively with the rest of the Customer Experience teams to ensure customer outcomes

  • Defining what ‘good’ looks like in terms of adoption plans, post-sales engagement, what is recommended and why

  • Working with Sales and Product teams to ensure our customers are getting the most out of the solution

  • Helping innovate our tooling and processes to make you and your team more efficient

  • Working on innovative and cutting edge customer projects

  • Learning our products and technologies, taking that knowledge and applying it to real world usage

  • Collaborating with other peers, business partners and groups. Representing not only yourself and the rest of your team but all of Kong and other exciting tasks you may identify to grow our company

What You'll Bring:

  • Have a builder’s mentality, seeking to find solutions to complex problems that will make life better for our customers and Kong

  • Manage a portfolio of commercial customers, looking for patterns that can be addressed through an automated approach using the latest customer engagement techniques

  • Have passion and determination about our technology and our customers

  • Be a self starter with strong organizational skills to drive effective customer outcomes

  • Have a good understanding of complex technology environments

  • Have great self awareness and strong communication skills

  • Ideally have prior experience of a similar role within SaaS, Open Source and/or Infrastructure software companies

  • Have a solid understanding of Cloud Native and the technologies that make it work (Containerization, Kubernetes, Microservices) as well as have a have a foundational understanding of APIM

  • Finally, understands the value of DevOps, CI/CD and Cloud Computing IaaS

  • Lead strategic account planning and identify new opportunities within enterprise accounts.

  • Partner across Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and technical teams to deliver the right solutions for customers.

About the Role:

Kong’s API Management suite includes the Kong Enterprise Gateway, the Konnect SaaS platform, and a variety of Managed Gateways in public clouds, such as AWS, Azure, and GCP. This suite of products helps customers in different industries (like finance, banking, e-commerce, airlines, etc.) manage their API platforms and operations at scale. Our customers expect secure, reliable, high-scale, low-latency offerings from Kong, whether running on-premise or in the public cloud.

A critical need for all our customers is to manage API Operations via Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools. Kong provides an open-source CLI - deck - that is the centrepiece of API Operations. (Source code for deck is at GitHub - Kong/deck: decK: Configuration management and drift detection for Kong. )

Terraform-provider: Terraform provider for Kong Konnect - Kong’s SaaS product

SDK for Go: Go SDK for Kong Konnect

SDKs in other languages and tooling to generate SDKs from APIs

API specification and tooling for all products of Kong

Build a CLI-first experience for Kong Konnect

We are looking to expand our Bangalore-based API Operations team by hiring a Software Engineer II to join the team and build out the API Operations toolset. We expect you to work in a hybrid fashion with three days a week in the office.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, develop and build the API Operations toolset for Kong, starting with deck.

  • Keep up with all of Kong’s API runtimes (HTTP gateway, AI gateway, Event gateway, etc.) and enable new features in the API Operations toolset.

  • Play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction for the evolution of API Operations.

  • Make CLI tools work for both humans and automation (inside GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).

  • Ship API changes to multiple tools at the same time without manual toil

  • Make and consistently raise the bar for world-class APIs for a company that helps the world build and run APIs

  • Collaborate closely with product leadership to define and refine strategy, roadmap, and objectives for the API Operations toolset, ensuring alignment between engineering efforts and business goals.

  • Assist in the hiring process and help grow and mentor the team.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in building high-performance software with Golang.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Prior operations experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools.

  • Experience building APIs, standardising APIs in large organisations, and creating API workflows.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate across teams.

  • Desire to join a fast-paced pre-IPO startup and the ability to move with high velocity to get things done.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.

About the Role:

Kong is the AI connectivity company. We help engineering teams manage, secure, and scale the APIs and AI traffic that power modern businesses.

India represents a significant growth opportunity for Kong. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build our marketing presence in the market from the ground up—turning strategic priorities into programs that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and establish Kong as a leader in API and AI connectivity.

This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.

Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.

What You’ll Do:

Own the India marketing strategy

  • Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.

  • Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.

  • Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.

  • Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

Build and execute account-based marketing

  • Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.

  • Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.

  • Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.

  • Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

Create demand that converts

  • Build integrated demand generation programs across digital, content, email, events, and partner channels.

  • Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.

  • Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.

  • Continuously optimize programs based on pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

Build the India events engine

  • Develop an events strategy spanning executive roundtables, technical workshops, webinars, industry conferences, and flagship experiences.

  • Create programs that bring together engineering leaders, enterprise decision-makers, developers, and strategic customers.

  • Own event planning, audience acquisition, execution, follow-up, and performance measurement.

  • Build a repeatable events model that prioritizes meaningful engagement and commercial outcomes over attendance numbers alone.

Turn partnerships into growth

  • Work with channel and technology partners to develop joint demand generation and co-marketing programs.

  • Equip partners with localized content, campaigns, event resources, and sales enablement.

  • Identify opportunities to extend Kong’s reach through strategic ecosystems and industry relationships.

Establish Kong’s presence in India

  • Adapt global brand campaigns and content for local market needs while maintaining consistency with Kong’s positioning.

  • Build relationships with relevant industry communities, technology leaders, and enterprise decision-makers.

  • Develop programs that strengthen awareness, credibility, and consideration among Kong’s target audiences.

Own the budget and prove impact

  • Manage the India field marketing budget, allocating investment against clear business priorities.

  • Establish dashboards and reporting that connect marketing activity to qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.

  • Share performance transparently, including what worked, what didn’t, and what should change.

  • Build a continuous improvement culture grounded in data, experimentation, and accountability.

What You’ll Bring:

  • A builder’s mindset. You’ve built a marketing function, regional program, or demand engine from scratch—not just operated an established one.

  • B2B technology marketing experience. You understand how to market complex technology solutions to enterprise buyers and translate technical value into business impact.

  • Strong ABM and demand generation expertise. You know how to prioritize accounts, engage buying groups, generate demand, and build programs that contribute to pipeline.

  • A track record in high-growth environments. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, limited resources, and the need to move quickly.

  • Cross-functional leadership. You can align Sales, global marketing, partners, and regional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • Events that deliver results. You know how to design experiences that build relationships, create opportunities, and justify the investment.

  • Commercial and analytical rigor. You understand pipeline metrics, conversion rates, campaign performance, and marketing efficiency—and know how to act on the data.

  • Deep knowledge of India’s enterprise technology landscape. You understand the accounts, industries, buying dynamics, and ecosystems that matter.

  • Clear, adaptable communication. You can build credibility with engineers, executives, sales teams, and marketing leaders alike.

What will set you apart:

  • Experience marketing APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity, or AI technologies.

  • Experience building channel marketing or partner-led demand generation programs.

  • Established relationships across India’s enterprise technology, financial services, or global capability center (GCC) ecosystem.

  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization while building programs tailored to a regional market.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - LATAM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

We’re seeking a committed Enterprise Sales Executive for our LATAM region, based in the U.S., with a successful background in sales and account management, ideally within open source or similar enterprise software environments.

We are living through the most significant technological shift since the dawn of the internet. At Kong, we aren't just watching the AI revolution, we are building the infrastructure that makes it possible. We are the intelligent nervous system for modern architecture, seamlessly connecting APIs, microservices, and LLMs for the world’s most ambitious brands.

As enterprises race to integrate AI, they face a wall of complexity. We are the bridge. We help the global 2000 modernize their legacy systems and securely unlock the power of AI across their entire organization. This isn't just sales; it’s architecting the future of global commerce.

The Role: Impact & Ownership:

We are looking for a strategic, high-achieving, and disciplined Enterprise Account Executive to join our world-class team. At Kong, we don't leave success to chance. We are a "master the craft" company. We rely on proven frameworks, deep technical curiosity, and collaborative execution.

If you thrive when navigating complex, high-stakes deals and love the challenge of selling transformational technology to visionary CTOs and Chief Architects, you’ve found your next home.

What You Will Achieve:

  • Pioneer New Markets: Lead the full sales cycle to welcome new six- and seven-figure enterprise partners into the Kong ecosystem.

  • Master the Framework: Use the MEDDIC methodology not just as an acronym, but as a strategic tool to uncover value, mitigate risk, and drive predictable success.

  • Navigate the C-Suite: Orchestrate complex, multi-threaded sales cycles, building deep trust with everyone from lead engineers to C-level executives.

  • Collaborative Excellence: Partner with our expert Solutions Engineering team to prove the massive ROI and technical superiority of the Kong platform.

  • Define Your Legacy: Maintain a pristine pipeline and deliver accurate forecasts that help shape the strategic direction of our sales organization.

What You Bring to the Journey

  • A Track Record of Excellence: 8+ years of experience selling complex enterprise software platforms, with a history of consistently exceeding goals and reaching the top tier of your organization.

  • Technical Curiosity: You have a passion for infrastructure, DevOps, or AI-enabling technologies. You don't just sell the product; you understand the "why" behind it.

  • Strategic Discipline: You value a structured approach. You know that sustainable, scalable success comes from mastering the playbook and executing with precision.

  • Executive Presence: You are a compelling storyteller, capable of articulating the strategic business value of AI and APIs to the world’s most sophisticated technical leaders.

  • Resilient Drive: You bring the persistence, grit, and proactive mindset required to win in a high-velocity, competitive landscape.

Why You’ll Thrive at Kong:

  • Category-Defining Technology: Sell a product that engineers genuinely love and that the world’s largest companies need to survive an AI-first world.

  • Uncapped Opportunity: A competitive base salary paired with an aggressive, uncapped commission structure that rewards those who go above and beyond.

  • Exponential Growth: We are scaling fast and we invest in our people. If you want to grow your career, we provide the path, the training, and the mentorship to get you there.

  • Inclusive Excellence: We offer comprehensive health coverage, equity, flexible PTO, and a culture where diverse perspectives are the fuel for our innovation.

Requirements:

  • Located in the U.S.

  • Native Spanish speaker, fluent in English (written and spoken)

  • Willing and able to travel to the LATAM region (Mexico to Argentina) at least 2x per quarter

jobs.title: Senior PLG Digital Growth Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is looking for a Senior PLG Digital Growth Manager to build and scale the digital growth engine behind our product-led motion.

This role will own Marketing's targets for qualified product signup growth and the strategy, experimentation, and execution required to achieve them. You'll focus on improving the journey from digital discovery through signup, while using downstream activation and product behavior to continuously improve the quality of users we acquire.

This is a hands-on growth role. We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, build a strategy, and roll up their sleeves to launch and optimize experiments—not simply recommend what other teams should do.

What You'll Do:

  • Own PLG growth targets and strategy: Own qualified signup goals and build the growth roadmap required to achieve them across acquisition, conversion, and experimentation.

  • Grow qualified product signups: Identify and scale the audiences, use cases, channels, and experiences that bring high-quality users into Kong's products.

  • Optimize the digital → product journey: Identify friction across landing pages, CTAs, signup paths, messaging, and conversion flows and turn those insights into experiments.

  • Build and ship experiments: Personally prototype, launch, measure, and iterate growth initiatives across landing experiences, signup journeys, lifecycle, new acquisition loops, and emerging channels.

  • Leverage AI to scale growth: Use AI and automation to accelerate experimentation, uncover insights, personalize digital experiences, automate repeatable workflows, and scale growth programs more efficiently.

  • Connect acquisition to activation: Partner with Product Growth to understand which users activate and engage, and use those signals to improve targeting, messaging, and acquisition.

  • Turn data into growth: Partner with RevOps on funnel measurement, attribution, cohort analysis, and product signals connecting acquisition → signup → activation → PQL → revenue.

  • Orchestrate across Marketing: Work across Digital Experience, SEO/AEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Content, and Campaigns to turn PLG opportunities into execution.

  • Lead cross-functional PLG growth: Partner with leaders across Marketing, Product Growth and RevOps to align priorities, influence roadmaps, and turn PLG growth opportunities into execution

How We'll Measure Success:

You'll be directly accountable for qualified product signup growth and the efficiency of the digital PLG funnel, including:

  • Qualified product signups

  • Marketing-sourced activated users

  • Web → signup conversion

  • Experiment velocity and incremental growth

You'll also use activation, PQL, pipeline, and revenue performance as downstream measures of acquisition quality.

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years in PLG, digital growth, growth marketing, growth product, or a related B2B SaaS discipline

  • Experience building or scaling self-service or product-led growth motions

  • A track record of personally building, launching, and optimizing growth experiments

  • Strong understanding of digital acquisition, CRO, experimentation, lifecycle, and funnel optimization

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using product, behavioral, and cohort data to drive growth decisions

  • Comfort with modern analytics, experimentation, automation, AI, and no-code/low-code growth tools

  • Ability to operate cross-functionally across Marketing, Product, RevOps, Analytics, and Engineering

  • A builder mentality with a bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

  • Experience with developer, infrastructure, API, cloud, or technical audiences strongly preferred

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Security Champion), Runtimes
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

At Kong, our API and AI Gateway sits at the center of how Fortune 500 enterprises and AI-native startups secure and govern the flow of intelligence.

Every request into a company's infrastructure goes through the Gateway first. Security isn't a side concern here, it's the top priority: you're guarding the front door.

You'll be securing AI traffic while the playbook is still being written: prompt injection, agentic authorization, MCP. These are problems nobody has fully solved yet.

We're looking for a Software Engineer with a security specialization to join our Runtimes team as a Security Champion: an engineer who writes real code and makes security a built-in part of how we ship.

What You'll Do:

  • Run security-focused code audits, threat modeling, and secure design reviews across our AI Gateway and API Gateway capabilities

  • Own vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, reproduction, remediation, verification

  • Partner with AI Gateway engineering on emerging AI/LLM threat patterns (ie: prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse)

  • Coach engineers on secure coding practices, turning security findings into lasting team habits

  • Contribute hands-on to Gateway feature work, with security built-in from day one

What You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years building production software, with 2+ years in a dedicated security role (AppSec, vulnerability research, or pentesting);

  • Solid coding skills in a object oriented language (Rust, Java, Python, Go, or similar);

  • Practical threat-modeling experience;

  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity (especially L7 security and authentication);

  • Basic knowledge of AI attack vectors.

Nice-to-have:

  • Familiarity with L7 proxies/API gateway architecture (Nginx, OpenResty, Envoy, HAProxy or Kong);

  • Experience with Lua;

  • Open-source contributions;

  • Willingness to learn Rust is important for where our platform is heading: we'll help you get there.

What we offer:

  • A permanent contract under the CCNL Commercio (Quadro)

  • Bonus and welfare system

  • Hybrid work from our Milan Hub at Talent Garden Isola, and a seat at the table where security decisions actually shape what millions of API calls run through every day.

  • CX + digital services

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Gateway - Shanghai
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

As Kong advances into the Agentic Era, the AI Gateway team is developing the vital infrastructure that links enterprise systems with generative AI technologies. In this position, you will focus on engineering the core system powering live AI traffic. You will take ownership of the runtime and data plane responsible for routing, translating, securing, and analyzing every request, ensuring performance, security, and scalability as AI workloads expand.

What You'll Do:

  • Responsible for designing, building and maintaining Kong’s AI Gateway runtime and its underlying data plane stack.

  • Architecture, design, and implement new innovative features including proxying capabilities, semantic/intelligent routing, load balancing, guardrails and compression, and identity, that extend Kong’s AI Gateway offering.

  • Build and maintain security, performance, and compliance foundations, including token cost management, access control, and low-level optimizations for production AI workloads.

  • Engage with the open source community and extend Kong core to support the latest industry trends.

  • Fill the gaps between Kong AI Gateway and third-party AI/ML providers, deployment platforms, and tooling.

  • And any additional tasks required by the manager.

What You'll Bring:

  • 8+ years of programming in server-side applications and components.

  • Experience designing, prototyping, building and debugging applications that are highly scalable, distributed, reliable and resilient.

  • Solid hands-on low-level technical expertise in Linux systems troubleshooting, and profiling.

  • Experience in distributed systems, Linux networking stack and computer systems programming, Kong works with APIs on both L7 and L4 transports and protocols, so this expertise and knowledge are required.

  • Comfortable working with a remotely distributed team.

  • Strong sense of ownership and excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Familiarity with AI LLM concepts and applications development.

Bonus Points:

  • Hands-on experience with NGINX/OpenResty/Kong/LuaJIT.

  • Hands-on experience with Envoy or Istio.

  • Hands-on experience with Rust.

  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI agents to deliver intricate software systems efficiently and with superior quality.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Control Plane
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission:

The Control Plane team architects the central nervous system of Kong's entire ecosystem. We build the high-performance, resilient, and scalable services that enable our users to configure and manage billions of API calls with confidence. This role is at the heart of delivering a world-class developer experience, ensuring our platform is not just powerful, but also intuitive and reliable at enterprise scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and implement core features for the Kong Gateway Control Plane, primarily using Golang.

  • Own the full lifecycle of services, from architectural design and implementation to deployment and operational excellence.

  • Lead technical discussions and architectural decisions to prevent technical debt and ensure our commitment to 99.99% uptime.

  • Influence the technical roadmap for our cloud-native components, advocating for best practices in a distributed systems environment.

  • Mentor other engineers through thoughtful code reviews and design sessions, fostering a culture of high-quality code and developer delight.

  • Collaborate with product managers and other engineering teams to architect and deliver impactful solutions for our global user base.

  • Resolve complex bugs and performance bottlenecks in our core networking and configuration management components.

What You’ll Bring:

The Toolkit

  • Significant professional experience writing and deploying production services in Golang.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design principles.

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and the cloud-native ecosystem.

  • Proficiency with relational databases, such as PostgreSQL.

  • Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices.

The Kong DNA

  • Ownership: A proactive, self-starting mindset with a bias for action and a sense of responsibility for the end-to-end user experience.

  • Urgency: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, pre-IPO environment, delivering high-impact work on ambitious timelines without sacrificing quality.

  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and a team-first attitude, adept at working across functions to achieve common goals.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with API gateways, service mesh (like Kuma), or related networking technologies.

  • Active contributions to open-source projects.

  • Knowledge of Lua or NGINX internals.

  • Experience building and managing large-scale SaaS platforms.

jobs.title: Account Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is The AI Connectivity Company. Our platform sits at the centre of how enterprises manage APIs, AI agents, and the infrastructure connecting them and we’re scaling fast. The ADR role is the front line of that growth. The accounts you open today are the expansion stories of tomorrow.

 

As a Majors / Enterprise Outbound ADR, you’ll identify and qualify new business opportunities across the EMEA Majors / Enterprise segment, working closely with our Sales and Marketing teams. This isn’t just a job, it’s the best way to fast-track a long career in tech sales.

 

We invest heavily in our people: a 4-week sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, continuous training throughout your tenure, and a leadership team that actually gets in the trenches with you. If you want an MBA in sales, this is the place to earn it.

 

Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: Meet your team, complete bootcamp, and fall in love with what Kong actually does.

  • Month 2: Pick up the phone with confidence, master our tech stach (Nooks, Claude, Gemini, Sumble, Lusha etc) and work your first live opportunity, and hit your ramp quota.

  • Month 3: Own your funnel, share what’s working, and what needs optimisation.

     

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and run outbound campaigns end-to-end, from idea to qualified meeting

  • Engage decision-makers across phone, email, LinkedIn, and video

  • Partner closely with AEs and Marketing, you’re a connector, not just a top-of-funnel rep

  • Keep Salesforce clean and your pipeline tighter, process matters here

  • Utilise AI to boost productivity, work at pace and personalise your messaging

  • Invest in your own development, your manager will meet you where you are and help you get to what’s next

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Some experience in a customer-facing or sales role — internships, retail, or hospitality count if you can show you know how to build rapport and drive outcomes

  • A hunter mentality, you’re not waiting to be handed leads, you go and find them

  • High coachability, you take feedback well, apply it fast, and ask for more

  • Strong communicator, clear and confident in writing and on a call

  • Genuine curiosity about technology - you don’t need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what Kong does and why it matters

     

Why Kong?

  • Be part of the company defining the future of AI connectivity. APIs and agents run on Kong

  • Real career development - our ADRs are the next wave of AEs in the tech, and our leadership team is invested in making that happen

  • Hybrid from our central London office - walking distance from Bank Station and London Bridge, 2–3 days a week in the office. A beautiful location to work from in Summer

  • Competitive comp, benefits, and a team that shows up with integrity, energy, and purpose

 

Every day, we raise the bar of what great looks like. Ready to help set it?

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Gateway
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission:

The AI Gateway team is at the forefront of Kong's evolution into the Agentic Era, building the critical infrastructure that connects enterprises to the world of generative AI. We are architecting a highly performant, secure, and observable gateway that provides developers with an unparalleled 'Developer Delight' experience for AI workloads. Your work will directly empower our customers to innovate faster by securely integrating LLMs and AI services into their applications at massive scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and own core components of our AI Gateway, ensuring 99.99% uptime and low-latency performance for critical AI traffic.

  • Lead the implementation of features like prompt engineering, caching, and observability for AI services, writing clean, maintainable Golang and/or Python code.

  • Influence the technical roadmap and architecture, proactively identifying and mitigating technical debt to ensure long-term scalability.

  • Architect robust solutions for integrating with various Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI platforms, shaping the future of API management for AI.

  • Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, high-ownership, and rapid iteration through code reviews and design discussions.

  • Drive the full development lifecycle, from ideation and design to deployment and operation within a modern Kubernetes environment.

  • Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to translate complex customer requirements into elegant and powerful technical solutions.

What You’ll Bring:

The Toolkit

  • 5+ years of experience in backend development, preferably with Golang and/or Python.

  • Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, LLMs, or frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design principles.

  • Proven experience designing and operating services in a cloud-native environment (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure).

  • Familiarity with API gateways, service mesh, or related infrastructure technologies.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, concurrency).

The Kong DNA

  • Ownership: You are a self-starter who takes initiative and sees features through from conception to production.

  • Urgency: You thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing quality with the need to deliver value to customers quickly.

  • Collaboration: You excel at working with a globally distributed team, communicating clearly and effectively to achieve shared goals.

Bonus Points:

  • Contributions to open-source projects.

  • Experience with performance tuning and optimization of high-throughput systems.

  • Knowledge of Lua/OpenResty.

You will join the engineering team that builds the Kong AI gateway, empowering companies and developers around the world to govern every step of their AI & LLM based innovation.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Nordics (Sweden)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is seeking a Regional Sales Leader to help us build and grow the Kong API platform and our Strategic Sales Team in the Nordics. We are searching for a seasoned industry leader who will lead our Enterprise Account Executives and drive business results and revenue. Reporting to the RVP of Northern EMEA, this senior leadership position will have ownership and accountability to ensure Kong maximizes our market potential bringing in new customers as well as growing our existing clients.

This leader will work closely with our other senior leaders to ensure decisions are driving the overall Kong business goals and our long term vision continues to thrive. You will play a part in reshaping and leading the incredible growth of Kong. It is the intention of the leadership team to build a high quality, sustainable and strong sales organization. To date, a significant amount of Kong’s success has been gained through the quality of our product, our global account base, our adoption by the open source community and by inbound leads.

You will build and strengthen a quality, scalable, regional sales team focused on acquisition of new brands and targeted account plans. Kong is the perfect environment for you to have a significant impact and grow our amazing company. We are a people first organization and expect you to be the same.

What You’ll Do:

  • Growing Kong’s presence and footprint in Strategic accounts in Nordics.

  • Driving a highly performant and highly accountable culture to achieve and exceed sales goals

  • Attract, hire and retain top talent through your network and in collaboration with the rest of the org

  • Provide strong coaching and mentorship on the sales process, PG, qualification and closing

  • Conduct weekly forecast meetings with your team and report to leadership

  • Collaborate effectively with Marketing, Partners, and all stakeholders

What You’ll Bring:

  • You have been a top performer as an IC and front-line manager with a track record of overachievement

  • Accurate forecasting at the individual and team levels

  • Ability to recruit, develop, and retain top talent

  • Strong territory management at a regional level

  • Proven systems/methodology for consistent pipeline generation

  • Experience using and teaching sales methodologies

  • Energy, passion, and rigour in your career as a Sales leader

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive Compensation & Equity: Attractive OTE, uncapped commissions, and stock options in a high-growth, pre-IPO company.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Health, dental, and vision coverage, plus generous parental leave.

  • Work-Life Balance: Company-wide Unplug Days, monthly U-First Fridays, and a 4-week paid sabbatical every 5 years.

  • Flexibility: Remote-first/hybrid work options and home office setup stipend.

  • Growth & Development: Learning and development support, leadership autonomy, and opportunities for career advancement.

  • Award-Winning Culture: Kong is Great Place To Work Certified™ in the U.S. for the fourth time, with 95% of surveyed employees saying Kong is a great place to work.

  • President’s Club: Exceptional performance is celebrated, with top sales performers having the opportunity to earn President’s Club.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Director - International
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is seeking an experienced and strategic International Director of Deal Desk to help build, scale, and lead a best-in-class deal desk and deal operations function supporting our international markets, including EMEA and AP. In this critical role, you’ll drive optimal deal structuring, pricing strategy, and operational efficiency to accelerate revenue growth, ensure compliance, and maximize deal value globally. Your expertise in managing complex deal negotiations, optimizing the quote-to-cash technology stack, and aligning cross-functional teams will be pivotal in delivering a seamless customer experience. As the International Deal Desk Director you will be a player-coach, partnering closely with Sales Leaders and Field Sellers.

This is an exciting opportunity to make a global impact by shaping Kong’s go-to-market strategy and deal desk operations across international markets. As an International Deal Desk Director, you’ll work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional teams, gaining high visibility while driving innovative solutions at a fast-growing, industry-leading company. You’ll have the chance to build and mentor a high-performing team, tackle complex enterprise deals, and contribute to a collaborative, people-first culture. We offer competitive compensation, equity, flexible work arrangements, and a comprehensive benefits package, all within an award-winning, growth-focused workplace.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership:

  • Take action, provide innovative solutions, and drive consistent improvement

  • Manage, recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing international deal desk team focused on customer-centricity, collaboration, and operational rigor

  • Foster a culture of accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement

  • Align with AMER Deal Desk team to ensure global consistency and foster collaboration

Deal Strategy:

  • Lead the execution of strategic pricing policies, discount guidelines, and approval frameworks across all international regions (EMEA and APJ)

  • Elevate pricing acumen within team and across Sales teams

  • Partner with Sales leaders, managers and sellers to align on Regional goals and strategies to close deals

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Legal and Product teams to structure complex enterprise deals ensuring competitive positioning and maximizing profitability

  • Develop KPI’s to track team engagement and deal influence

  • Work closely with Product and GTM teams during new product introductions to help define optimal pricing, packaging, and deal structures that maximize market adoption and profitability

  • Develop and deliver regular training and enablement programs for sales and related teams on pricing, deal structures, quoting tools, and deal processes

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, and Customer Success teams to improve deal velocity, transparency, and adherence to company policies

  • Act as a trusted advisor to sales teams, providing expertise on deal structuring, negotiations, pricing, and risk assessment

Operational Excellence:

  • Establish and enforce global deal desk policies and governance to ensure compliance and minimize operational risks

  • Regularly analyze deal desk performance metrics, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions to drive continuous improvement and scalability

  • Lead initiatives to continuously streamline processes and automate manual activities within the Deal Desk to scale operations

Reporting and Analytics:

  • Develop comprehensive analytics and reporting frameworks to monitor deal performance, trends, pricing dynamics, and compliance

  • Provide strategic insights and recommendations to senior leadership based on data-driven analysis

Qualifications:

  • Strategic thinker and problem solver who can thrive in high-growth, fast-paced environments.

  • Exceptional communicator capable of clearly articulating complex issues to diverse stakeholders.

  • Experienced, collaborative leader who empowers teams and fosters a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.

  • Extensive experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or related roles

  • Relevant experience supporting EMEA and APJ regions

  • Deep expertise in quote-to-cash technologies and processes

  • Proven ability to design, implement, and optimize pricing and deal management strategies

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; adept at influencing Sales teams at all organizational levels and engaging with Executive leaders

  • Strong understanding of financial modeling, profitability analysis, and commercial terms negotiation

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a passion for building and developing teams.

  • Experience scaling operational processes in fast-growing, global technology or SaaS companies.

  • Demonstrated expertise in consumption-based pricing models and strategies.

  • Responsible for the design, build, and management of partner programs that support Kong's channel business.

  • Develop partner program collateral, documentation, and onboarding tools to enhance the overall partner experience and communicate program details to partners

  • Develop the partner portal, leveraging Salesforce (SFDC) and a partner relationship management (PRM) system, working with Marketing and Channel Operations

  • Manage and administer the partner portal to create an engaging platform for partners to interact with Kong (lead registration, opportunity tracking, commissions, etc.)

  • Manage and administer partner agreements and partner contracting, in coordination with Legal

  • Communicate channel programs, strategies, events, and updates internally to drive alignment throughout the business

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Legal, and Finance to continue to implement and grow partner programs, and ensure alignment across the business

  • Work with partners to solicit feedback on existing programs/processes and implement changes (e.g., Partner Advisory Councils, via channel teams)

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

On the Konnect Metering & Billing team at Kong, you’ll design, build, and maintain the backend services behind two products: usage metering and billing, and AI Cost Management (Tokenomics), which gives customers visibility and control over what their AI usage costs. As a Backend Engineer, you’ll work closely with Engineering and Product to build scalable services and APIs that process millions of events per second and have a direct, measurable impact on our customers.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain microservices and APIs for usage metering, billing, invoicing, and analytics at scale.

  • Build AI Cost Management capabilities that help customers track, attribute, and control LLM token usage and spend, including cost attribution, budgets, and usage limits.

  • Architect backend systems that process millions of events per second in real time.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to define system requirements and ship high-quality, customer-focused solutions.

  • Optimize database performance and ensure data integrity, reliability, and security across distributed systems.

  • Integrate with third-party services (e.g., Stripe, CRMs) to support billing and reporting needs.

  • Support production services through monitoring, troubleshooting, and on-call rotation to keep them highly available.

  • Apply best practices for DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud-native development.

  • Write automated tests to validate system behavior and prevent regressions.

  • And any additional tasks required by your manager.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Experience with Go, Node.js.

  • Contributions to open source projects.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).

  • Exposure to big data systems (e.g., ClickHouse), streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka), and event-driven architectures.

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.

  • Proven experience building scalable backend services.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver and maintain production systems at scale.

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and database optimization.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Bonus points:

  • Familiarity with LLM APIs, token-based pricing, or AI gateway and observability tooling.

  • Experience working on developer-focused products.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer - Central
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:
Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers.


What You’ll Do:

  • Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform.

  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production.

  • Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts.

  • Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs.

  • Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements.

  • Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.

  • Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API & AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.

  • Run API & AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures.

  • Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close.

  • Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

  • Drive thought leadership by authoring technical blogs, hosting webinars, speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, API & AI summit, and regional events

  • Influence product direction by synthesizing customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the product team.

  • And any additional tasks required by manager.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company.

  • Proven track record owning complex, enterprise-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent is required.

  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance.

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns.

  • Solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models.

  • Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives.

  • Enthusiasm for working in a high-profile, fast-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission:

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99.99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global SaaS scale.

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this multi-tenant SaaS platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business.

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance.

  • Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions.

  • Drive 4-9s (99.99%+) availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale.

  • Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's SaaS infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally.

  • Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function.

  • Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil.

  • Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features.

What You'll Bring:

The Toolkit:

  • Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating.

  • Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams.

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and container orchestration in production environments.

  • Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development.

  • Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures.

  • Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus.

The Kong DNA:

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion.

  • Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.

  • Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities.

  • Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKAD).

  • Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management.

#LI-PC1

For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Switzerland
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About The Role:

We are seeking a committed Enterprise Account Executive with a successful background in sales and account management, ideally within open source or similar enterprise software environments. In this role, you will be a key driver of our growth strategy, directly impacting the stability and expansion of our recurring revenue. This position is ideal for a sales professional who has experience in landing new clients, retaining existing customers, and driving account expansion for early-stage enterprise products in a dynamic, entrepreneurial setting.

What You’ll Do:

Develop and execute sales strategies to target enterprise customers, focusing on building and maintaining a robust pipeline that drives long-term growth.

  • Own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and initial outreach to contract negotiations and closing deals, while consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including product, marketing, and customer success, to ensure a seamless sales experience and alignment on customer needs.

  • Identify customer pain points and align our solutions to address these, delivering customized product demos and presentations tailored to their specific business needs.

  • Build and nurture relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers within target accounts, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

  • Lead account planning efforts by researching potential customers, understanding industry trends, and developing strategies to win new business and grow existing accounts.

  • Monitor and manage sales activities and results, accurately forecasting opportunities and keeping detailed records of interactions and progress in CRM systems.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market changes to position our product effectively and maintain a competitive edge.

  • Contribute to business growth initiatives, providing feedback to product and marketing teams to influence product development and go-to-market strategies.

  • Represent Kong with professionalism, acting as a brand ambassador at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

     

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise sales (>1k employees), with a proven track record of closing complex deals in a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment.

  • Demonstrated success in selling to large enterprises, particularly to senior-level executives and across multiple departments.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and present compelling solutions that drive business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of managing high-stakes conversations and building lasting relationships with stakeholders.

  • A results-driven mindset, with a passion for meeting and exceeding sales goals and revenue targets.

  • Experience working with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and leveraging data to forecast accurately and track sales metrics.

  • Knowledge of open-source software, APIs, or infrastructure software is highly advantageous.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, taking ownership of your sales territory and adapting to changing market dynamics.

  • Analytical and strategic thinking, with a knack for identifying business growth opportunities and devising plans to capitalize on them.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, GTM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

We are looking for a GTM Forward Deployed Engineer to build and launch AI agents for our go to market (GTM) teams (Marketing, Sales, Product and Revenue Operations) using platforms like Salesforce, Slack, Claude Code, Gemini, Snowflake, Marketo, Clay, Nooks, and Rox

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prototype and deploy AI agents for customer retention, pipeline generation, GTM productivity, deal inspection, account research, opportunity updates, and meeting prep.

  • Create prompt templates and system instructions for accurate, consistent outputs.

  • Define agent persona, tone, and fallback logic

  • Re-engineer GTM processes by connecting LLMs to GTM systems

  • Build and test agentic tools quickly.

  • Document agent logic and prompt structures to ensure scalable, independent automation across the global GTM organization.

  • Test system prompts, context retrieval, and model selection to boost output quality, seller adoption, and deal velocity.

  • Track and audit production agents to quickly fix output drift, performance gaps, and accuracy issues

  • Partner with GTM Analytics teams to integrate GTM data sources for real-time customer and pipeline insights.

  • Create practical prompt libraries, quick-reference playbooks, and training sessions to maximize seller, customer and/or potential customer value.

  • Ensure prompt, workflow, and deployed solutions meet security, legal, and company AI standards.

Required Qualifications:

  • Have 5+ years of software engineering experience

  • Working knowledge of GTM strategy, AI Operations and hands-on experience putting AI workflows or LLM agents into production.

  • Experience creating internal documentation, toolkits and playbooks that outlived your involvement and were adopted at scale.

  • Experience in a technical or cross-functional role that required problem-solving across teams and functions.

  • A track record of building AI-powered tools, automations, or workflows that changed how real work gets done — with specific examples you can speak to.

  • Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain a technical concept to someone who's never thought about it before, without talking down to them.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and self-direction; you don't need a detailed roadmap to know where to start.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with AI development platforms and tools such as Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, LLM APIs, custom agent frameworks, or workflow automation platforms.

  • Background in change management, organizational development, or a large-scale rollout that required bringing skeptical stakeholders along.

  • Experience in solutions engineering where you had to earn trust and deliver results quickly.

  • Familiarity with the enterprise SaaS tools Kong runs on: Okta, Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Jira, or Freshservice.

  • Familiarity with Kong Konnect, Kong Gateway, or API management concepts — understanding how APIs and AI models connect will help you build smarter tools.

  • Experience helping others develop new technical skills, whether through formal training, one-on-one coaching, or team enablement programs

jobs.title: Director Partner Programs & Operations Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Partners are one of Kong's biggest levers for AI Gateway pipeline and bookings, and our partner business is growing fast. Kong is hiring a Director, Partner Operations to build the operating model that helps it scale.

You'll be the operating partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders, sitting in Revenue Operations. You own how partner business flows through Kong — registration, deal structure, attribution, crediting, and payout — and you bring an AI-first mindset to how it runs.


Key responsibilities:

Business partner to Ecosystem leadership
Serve as the strategic and operational partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders across theaters. Run an AI-assisted operating cadence — forecast and pipeline reviews, QBRs, and executive reporting — where the prep is automated and meetings go to decisions. Facilitate cross-functional alignment on people, then process, then systems, so changes are agreed before they are configured.

Partner GTM strategy & planning
Lead annual and quarterly planning for the partner organization, including targets, capacity, and coverage. Help build a business that maximizes the impact of partner investments and resources.

Rules of engagement, deal registration & attribution
Own the rules that govern how partner deals are registered, protected, sourced, and credited, including sourced vs. influenced credit, lookback windows, and the line between partner credit and partner marketing credit. Encode them into systems and agents so they apply automatically.

Partner lead & deal workflows: Define and own how partner-touched leads and deals move between ADR, PSD, and AE, including routing, SLAs, and prioritization. Cover partner event leads, prospective partners, existing partners, and deal registrations, and give PSDs one view of the leads that need their action.

Partner deal execution
Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to make partner deals easy to structure, discount, and book across resale, referral, and cloud marketplace routes

Partner compensation & crediting
Partner with Incentive Compensation on channel-neutral crediting and referral fees, so sellers choose the best route to market.

Manage cloud marketplace operations: Own Kong’s cloud marketplace operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including listings, private offers, channel partner private offers (CPPOs), and co-sell registration. Lead the launch of marketplaces in new regions, and manage marketplace dynamics with Deal Desk, Finance, and the cloud alliances team, including fees, customer commit drawdown, and partner involvement on marketplace deals.

Performance insights & data quality
Define and report the partner KPIs that matter, give every partner leader a run-the-business view, and keep partner data accurate.

Partner marketing measurement & MDF
Work closely with Partner Marketing and Marketing Ops to define how partner marketing is measured. Tie MDF and event spend to registered deals by capturing funding source on deal registrations, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately.
Operational playbooks & enablement
Build and maintain the partner operations handbook and repeatable workflows, from partner onboarding to software access, including prospective partner intake and ADR and PSD training on routing rules, so every seller knows the process on day one.

Systems & data architecture
Own partner data design and routing rules. That includes partner account structure, alignment of deal registration approval with lead routing, and alerts when opportunities open on partner accounts. Evaluate whether the PRM remains the right long-term fit.

AI & automation roadmap
Own the Partner Operations AI roadmap: find the highest-leverage workflows, build or buy the agents and automations, and measure the hours returned to the field. Own business requirements for partner tooling across Salesforce, PRM, and CPQ.

Lean, high-output team
Build a small team of AI-native operators, and work across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to drive change as the ecosystem scales.

Required Experience:

  • 10+ years in Partner or Channel Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure software company, including 3+ years leading partner operations - with direct ownership of deal registration, rules of engagement, and partner attribution.

  • 3+ years experience operating a multi-type, multi-region partner ecosystem - GSIs, regional SIs, resellers, distributors, ISVs, and hyperscalers.

  • Hands-on partner deal execution end to end - resale, referral, and cloud marketplace transactions, partner discounting, and order form requirements - in partnership with Deal Desk and Finance.

  • 3+ years experience leading partner planning - targets, quota, capacity, and coverage and designing channel-neutral crediting with Incentive Compensation.

  • Proven track record as a trusted advisor to VP-level Partner or Sales leaders, with the presence to hold a governance line and the judgment to know when to evolve it.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency (opportunity design, sourcing fields, reporting) plus PRM and BI tools, and hands-on use of AI tools to automate ops workflows.

Preferred experience:

  • Hyperscaler co-sell and marketplace mechanics: AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate, Marketplace private offers, Microsoft co-sell, and Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

  • Experience supporting a shift to usage-based or consumption pricing and reflecting it in partner deal structures and crediting.

  • Experience leading a team from building processes to running them at scale.

  • API, cloud infrastructure, or AI platform experience.
