Lead the launch of marketplaces in new regions, and manage marketplace dynamics with Deal Desk, Finance, and the cloud alliances team, including fees, customer commit drawdown, and partner involvement on marketplace deals.

Performance insights & data quality
Define and report the partner KPIs that matter, give every partner leader a run-the-business view, and keep partner data accurate.

Partner marketing measurement & MDF
Work closely with Partner Marketing and Marketing Ops to define how partner marketing is measured. Tie MDF and event spend to registered deals by capturing funding source on deal registrations, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately.
Operational playbooks & enablement
Build and maintain the partner operations handbook and repeatable workflows, from partner onboarding to software access, including prospective partner intake and ADR and PSD training on routing rules, so every seller knows the process on day one.

Systems & data architecture
Own partner data design and routing rules. That includes partner account structure, alignment of deal registration approval with lead routing, and alerts when opportunities open on partner accounts. Evaluate whether the PRM remains the right long-term fit.

AI & automation roadmap
Own the Partner Operations AI roadmap: find the highest-leverage workflows, build or buy the agents and automations, and measure the hours returned to the field. Own business requirements for partner tooling across Salesforce, PRM, and CPQ.

Lean, high-output team
Build a small team of AI-native operators, and work across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to drive change as the ecosystem scales.

Required Experience:

 - 10+ years in Partner or Channel Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure software company, including 3+ years leading partner operations - with direct ownership of deal registration, rules of engagement, and partner attribution.

 - 3+ years experience operating a multi-type, multi-region partner ecosystem - GSIs, regional SIs, resellers, distributors, ISVs, and hyperscalers.

 - Hands-on partner deal execution end to end - resale, referral, and cloud marketplace transactions, partner discounting, and order form requirements - in partnership with Deal Desk and Finance.

 - 3+ years experience leading partner planning - targets, quota, capacity, and coverage  and designing channel-neutral crediting with Incentive Compensation.

 - Proven track record as a trusted advisor to VP-level Partner or Sales leaders, with the presence to hold a governance line and the judgment to know when to evolve it.

 - Deep Salesforce fluency (opportunity design, sourcing fields, reporting) plus PRM and BI tools, and hands-on use of AI tools to automate ops workflows.

Preferred experience:

 - Hyperscaler co-sell and marketplace mechanics: AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate, Marketplace private offers, Microsoft co-sell, and Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

 - Experience supporting a shift to usage-based or consumption pricing and reflecting it in partner deal structures and crediting.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

You'll make our customers' first strategic AI use case work securely, in production, in their real environment. Not a demo. Not a proof-of-concept that quietly dies. Real traffic, real identity, real policy.

As a Forward-Deployed Engineer in EMEA, you'll sit with platform, security and engineering teams at some of the region's most important enterprises, and own the technical path from first discovery call to a workload that's actually running. You're a builder with enterprise architecture instincts, credible with staff engineers and security architects, and comfortable owning ambiguity across APIs, AI Gateway, agents, MCP, identity and policy.

This is not a demo-only SE role, and it's not a ticket-based implementation consultancy. You own technical success for strategic AI opportunities end to end, then take what you learn back into Kong's own engineering team to make the next deal faster.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead AI, API and agentic technical discovery with customer platform, security and engineering teams.

  • Design runtime architecture across models, APIs, MCP and tool access, identity and policy.

  • Build prototypes, integrations, evaluation flows and reference implementations that prove Kong governs real production traffic.

  • Remove blockers in pilot and production: auth, network, observability, latency and cost.

  • Own the technical path from pilot to paid, and stay on it until the workload is running.

  • Turn what you build into reusable patterns, so the next AI Gateway deal is faster and cheaper to win.

  • Spend regular time embedded with Kong's internal engineering team, pairing on AI Gateway and agentic roadmap work.

  • Feed field patterns and roadmap-critical requirements straight back to Product, before competitors define the narrative.

  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering and Customer Success across EMEA on strategic AI opportunities.

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong hands-on engineering background, with experience building and shipping production software (Go, Python, TypeScript or similar).

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as forward-deployed, solutions architecture, staff or principal engineering, or technical consulting.

  • Enterprise architecture instincts: you can design for identity, network, security and observability constraints in complex environments.

  • Working knowledge of LLM and agentic patterns: model APIs, tool calling, MCP, evaluation and cost and latency trade-offs.

  • Experience with API gateways or infrastructure: Kubernetes, service mesh, OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, policy enforcement.

  • Credibility with staff engineers and security architects. You can lead a technical discussion from whiteboard to working code.

  • You own outcomes, not tickets. You're comfortable with ambiguity and drive work to done.

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English; additional European languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites across EMEA as needed.

Bonus points

  • Prior experience at an AI-native, developer-platform or infrastructure company.

  • Experience with Kong Gateway, Konnect or other API management platforms.

  • Open source contributions, or a track record of publishing reference architectures or patterns.

About the Role:

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The infrastructure layer for the AI shift is being decided now. Kong's edge is field-earned enterprise trust, and you'll extend it into the AI conversation: fluent in where AI is going, and unwavering as an enterprise infrastructure company.

As our AI Evangelist, you'll lead AI acceleration across EMEA, moving customers from AI experimentation to governed, production-grade AI and agents. You'll be the trusted technical advisor to CTOs, CIOs and AI leaders, framing the value of AI connectivity as cost, risk and revenue.

You'll work alongside our Account Executives and Solutions Engineers, not instead of them. They own the deal. You lead the conversation that gets the economic buyer to say yes, and every engagement you run moves AI traffic and AI revenue forward.

What You'll Do:

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to CTOs, CIOs and AI leaders, and sponsor strategic deals.

  • Lead the AI Connectivity Workshop once the AE has qualified the opportunity. Each one ends in a documented use case and a technical handoff that accelerates the deal.

  • Frame AI connectivity in terms executives care about: cost, risk and revenue.

  • Run executive briefings and join AI ecosystem conversations when a customer pulls you in.

  • Support AEs and SEs in reaching the economic buyer and in building multi-stakeholder buy-in, including the security leader.

  • Replicate wins between EMEA and set up use-case sharing across both regions.

  • Upskill AEs and SEs on AI and agentic positioning.

  • Route field use cases, blockers and competitive intel into Product, and track how AI budget ownership is evolving inside customers.

  • Work within International GTM strategy, in close partnership with Sales, SE leadership and Product.

What You'll Bring:

  • Deep technical credibility in AI, LLMs and agentic systems, plus a solid grounding in APIs, networking and enterprise infrastructure.

  • Experience advising or selling to CTOs, CIOs and AI leaders at large enterprises, in a pre-sales, solutions, field CTO, technical evangelist or similar role.

  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into a clear business case that lands with executives and with practitioners.

  • Strong facilitation skills: you can run a workshop with senior stakeholders and leave with a documented use case and clear next steps.

  • Comfort working through others. You influence deals without owning them and build trust through expertise and follow-through.

  • A collaborative, enabling style: you make AEs and SEs sharper on AI conversations.

  • Experience working across regions and cultures, ideally in both EMEA.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English; additional EMEA languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA for customer engagements and events.

Bonus points:

  • Experience at an API management, cloud infrastructure, security or AI platform company.

  • A public profile in the AI or developer community, such as speaking, writing or open source.

  • Familiarity with AI ecosystem players and how enterprise AI budgets are owned and funded.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Writer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Our docs get used in a few different ways. Some people land on a page in the middle of a task and just need the answer. Others are working out how to run Kong across a whole company, with real traffic and a lot of teams. The docs also power agent workflows, ours and our customers', like MCP servers and AI assistants. So when a page is wrong, it's wrong everywhere.

You'll own the docs for at least one product area, and you'll decide what to work on based on what you see. What features are releasing? Where are people getting stuck? What are the field teams hearing? You won't spend all your time in your area, though. You'll work with the other docs writers every day, check in with them when your work is done, ask for help when you're buried, and weigh in on each other's problems. You'll also work closely with product managers and engineers, and you'll be in their conversations early.

We own our docs platform, too. If a workflow could be better, you can build a better one. Add Vale rules, upgrade the platform, set up auto-generated docs. We have a docs engineer that can help you turn your needs into real features!

What You'll Do:

Own your product area

  • Own the documentation strategy for your area. That means getting into the product, seeing what's about to ship, deciding what needs writing, and planning the work. Share that plan with the docs team so everyone knows what's in motion. If something looks off, we'll sort it out together.

  • Work with product and field teams to find where a docs gap is blocking someone, and bring the data: user behavior, field feedback, adoption numbers. Who asked loudest shouldn't decide what gets written.

  • Sit in on product management discussions and say what you're seeing, so the docs and the product strategy stay in step.

Write it and test it

  • Write and edit how-to guides, reference documentation, and the pages that point people where they need to go, like landing pages and overviews.

  • Test everything you write. You're usually the first person outside engineering to use a new feature, so run the software, talk to the experts, and use the command line and API testing tools. If the steps don't work, the page isn't finished.

  • Review docs for technical accuracy and make sure they follow our guidelines.

Keep it all current

  • Maintain what's already published. Update it, revise it, and deprecate what's out of date.

  • Improve how we do docs, including document management and version control in Git, and help plan docs work so it ships on schedule.

What You'll Bring:

Must have

  • You've worked alongside other technical writers on a docs team, not just with engineers or a manager, and you're comfortable giving and getting reviews

  • You've worked as a technical writer at a software company or a startup

  • Experience working with AI and AI-native workflows (building skills using MCP servers)

  • An understanding of how to test software, including APIs and command line tools, and hands-on experience doing it

  • Comfort working in the command line, and solid Git experience

  • Experience maintaining, managing, and reviewing docs in a docs-as-code environment

#LI-JF1

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is scaling rapidly, and we are establishing an Executive IT Support function to provide seamless, frictionless technology experiences for our executive leadership team.

As our first dedicated Senior Executive IT & Events Engineer, you will not only provide high-touch, "white-glove" support, but also act as a foundational architect for the service. You will define standard operating procedures (SOPs), establish executive SLAs, elevate corporate event production, and drive operational excellence across our IT ecosystem. Beyond executive care, you will bridge the gap between high-level leadership needs and our broader IT service desk and infrastructure engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Service Definition & Program Architecture

Define the Service Offering: Partner with IT leadership to design and document the Executive Support framework, including service tiers, SLAs, escalation protocols, and standard operating procedures.

Proactive VIP Experience: Build a proactive support model—including preventative hardware audits, travel preparedness kits, and VIP onboarding/offboarding workflows.

Vendor & Asset Strategy: Curate and maintain a standardized catalog of high-performance hardware, peripherals, and home-office equipment tailored for executive productivity.

White-Glove Executive Support

Rapid Response: Deliver immediate, confidential, and empathetic technical assistance to executive leadership team, and executive business partners (EBPs) across macOS, iOS, Windows, and Android environments.

Manage executive technology readiness by proactively monitoring devices, applications, meeting room technology, and collaboration tools

Coordinate with administrative assistants and executive support teams globally to ensure a seamless technology experience

Security & Confidentiality: Handle sensitive information, data and access with the utmost discretion.

Corporate Events & Audio/Visual (AV)

Executive & Leadership Meetings: Provide technical coverage and redundancy for executive & leadership meetings.

Company All-Hands, Marketing Events & Broadcasts: Lead technical staging and live production for marketing & corporate events, leadership meetings, town halls, customer briefings, and executive broadcasts

Conference Room Health: Maintain optimal performance of executive conference room systems and digital collaboration spaces.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

VIP Asset Management: Define and procure service related to providing loaner executive hardware ready for immediate deployment in case of hardware failure or travel emergencies.

Runbooks & Knowledge Base: Author comprehensive runbooks for executive support scenarios to enable seamless coverage across the IT team during off-hours or travel.

Metrics & Feedback: Establish feedback loops with executive assistants and leaders to track satisfaction, identify recurring friction points, and continually optimize service delivery.

Cross-Functional IT & Infrastructure Collaboration

Team Collaboration: Act as an escalation point for Tier 2/Tier 3 internal IT support issues, sharing executive insights to enhance broader end-user computing standards.

Infrastructure Synergy: Collaborate with our infrastructure service providers to support site buildouts and infrastructure standards and solutions for the broader organization.

Beta Testing & Rollouts: Participate and in some cases lead piloting of new software deployments, security policies, and productivity tools before company-wide rollouts.

What You'll Bring (Qualifications):

Experience: 5+ years in IT desktop support or systems engineering, with at least 2+ years supporting C-level executives, venture partners, or board members in a fast-paced technology or high-growth SaaS environment.

Technical Mastery:

Deep expertise in macOS management and troubleshooting (Jamf/Iru) alongside solid proficiency in Windows 11 (Intune/Entra ID).

Strong administration experience with modern enterprise SaaS suites: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Okta, 1Password, and Jira/Confluence.

Experience with AV/video conferencing hardware and control software (Zoom Rooms, Neat, Crestron, Shure audio systems).

Firm grasp of home networking troubleshooting (mesh Wi-Fi systems, DNS, VPNs, bandwidth contention, ISP issues).

Communication & Composure: Impeccable verbal and written communication skills. Proven track record of staying calm, poised, and decisive under high-pressure, time-sensitive circumstances.

Discretion: An uncompromising standard of professional integrity, emotional intelligence, and respect for confidential business matters.

Availability: Flexibility to provide occasional on-call assistance outside standard working hours and travel as needed for high-profile executive events or board meetings.

Nice to Have:

Prior experience designing and launching an executive or concierge IT support model from scratch.

Professional certifications (e.g., Apple Certified Support Professional, Jamf Certified Tech, Okta Certified Professional, CompTIA Network+/Security+).

Familiarity with streaming/broadcasting tools (OBS, vMix, hardware switchers) for live hybrid events.

Basic scripting or automation skills (Python, Claude, Claude Code, API integrations via n8n.

Rapid Response: Deliver immediate, confidential, and empathetic technical assistance to executive leadership team, and executive business partners (EBPs) across macOS, iOS, Windows, and Android environments.

Manage executive technology readiness by proactively monitoring devices, applications, meeting room technology, and collaboration tools

Coordinate with administrative assistants and executive support teams globally to ensure a seamless technology experience

Security & Confidentiality: Handle sensitive information, data and access with the utmost discretion.

Corporate Events & Audio/Visual (AV)

Executive & Leadership Meetings: Provide technical coverage and redundancy for executive & leadership meetings.

Company All-Hands, Marketing Events & Broadcasts: Lead technical staging and live production for marketing & corporate events, leadership meetings, town halls, customer briefings, and executive broadcasts

Conference Room Health: Maintain optimal performance of executive conference room systems and digital collaboration spaces.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

VIP Asset Management: Define and procure service related to providing loaner executive hardware ready for immediate deployment in case of hardware failure or travel emergencies.

Runbooks & Knowledge Base: Author comprehensive runbooks for executive support scenarios to enable seamless coverage across the IT team during off-hours or travel.

Metrics & Feedback: Establish feedback loops with executive assistants and leaders to track satisfaction, identify recurring friction points, and continually optimize service delivery.

Cross-Functional IT & Infrastructure Collaboration

Team Collaboration: Act as an escalation point for Tier 2/Tier 3 internal IT support issues, sharing executive insights to enhance broader end-user computing standards.

Infrastructure Synergy: Collaborate with our infrastructure service providers to support site buildouts and infrastructure standards and solutions for the broader organization.

Beta Testing & Rollouts: Participate and in some cases lead piloting of new software deployments, security policies, and productivity tools before company-wide rollouts.



What You'll Bring (Qualifications):



Experience: 5+ years in IT desktop support or systems engineering, with at least 2+ years supporting C-level executives, venture partners, or board members in a fast-paced technology or high-growth SaaS environment.

Technical Mastery:

Deep expertise in macOS management and troubleshooting (Jamf/Iru) alongside solid proficiency in Windows 11 (Intune/Entra ID).

Strong administration experience with modern enterprise SaaS suites: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Okta, 1Password, and Jira/Confluence.

Experience with AV/video conferencing hardware and control software (Zoom Rooms, Neat, Crestron, Shure audio systems).

Firm grasp of home networking troubleshooting (mesh Wi-Fi systems, DNS, VPNs, bandwidth contention, ISP issues).

Communication & Composure: Impeccable verbal and written communication skills. Proven track record of staying calm, poised, and decisive under high-pressure, time-sensitive circumstances.

Discretion: An uncompromising standard of professional integrity, emotional intelligence, and respect for confidential business matters.

Availability: Flexibility to provide occasional on-call assistance outside standard working hours and travel as needed for high-profile executive events or board meetings.



Nice to Have:

Prior experience designing and launching an executive or concierge IT support model from scratch.

Professional certifications (e.g., Apple Certified Support Professional, Jamf Certified Tech, Okta Certified Professional, CompTIA Network+/Security+).

Familiarity with streaming/broadcasting tools (OBS, vMix, hardware switchers) for live hybrid events.

Basic scripting or automation skills (Python, Claude, Claude Code, API integrations via n8n.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

A strong partner ecosystem is crucial to the success and growth of Kong's business. Partners are a strategic imperative for Kong's continued growth and market expansion. As customer requirements become more complex, we need partners with the capability and capacity to help customers implement, support and grow their usage of Kong. We work closely with cross-functional leadership to ensure partners are integrated throughout the sales cycle, both pre- and post-sale.

About the Role:

The Partner Sales Director owns Kong's partner business within the DACH territory. That means recruiting the right partners, building a real go-to-market motion with them, and driving sourced incremental revenue, not slideware pipeline. The PSD is the single point of contact for anything partner-related: for field sellers who need partner help on a deal, for partners who need a path into Kong, and for leadership setting regional strategy. The ecosystem spans channel resellers, technology partners, GSIs, and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and the PSM works across all four. At the Intermediate level and above, this is a senior individual contributor role: the PSD runs their territory as their own business, in close partnership with the territory's sales leader.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the partner revenue number for your assigned territory. Sell Kong's full portfolio (products, renewals, professional services, and support) through and with focus partners.

  • Build the joint go-to-market plan with your territory's sales team. Identify and sign new partners where there are gaps.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline: set targets, run the cadence, and hold partners (and yourself) accountable to them, favoring net-new sourced business over tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway.

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by coordinating deal registration, lead sharing, and co-selling motions for Kong Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Mesh, and Konnect.

  • Build joint assets with focus partners, such as reference architectures, blueprints, and solution briefs that field teams on both sides actually use.

  • Run joint marketing events that generate pipeline, not just logos on a banner.

  • Get inside your partners' business: understand how they make money, where Kong fits, and what it takes to win together. Pull in the right cross-functional support (enablement, CX, marketing, ops) to make the projects land.

  • Build a focus partner plan for your territory and execute it alongside sales engineering, SDRs, customer success, and marketing.

  • Partner with and Partner Sales Engineers to ensure partners have the technical readiness needed to sell and deliver Kong solutions.

  • Build, maintain, and manage relationships with the Kong field sales organization. Proactively engage with Kong AEs, ASMs and geo leadership.

  • Coordinate and facilitate the involvement of Kong team members, including sales leadership and support, as needed to meet sales targets and partner sales objectives.

  • Facilitate territory mapping and identification of new joint opportunities. Resolve route conflicts appropriately.

  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews (QBRs) within your assigned territory, and participate in annual planning within the Partner organization.

  • Provide weekly forecasts and/or progress reports, and keep partner and opportunity data current in Salesforce and other partner management systems.

  • Escalate critical business issues to Partner Sales team management.

  • Prepare presentations, territory plans and reports as required.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with Finance, Partner Operations, Sales Operations, and Sales as needed.

Requirements:

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the role, please apply. Nobody checks every box. We're looking for candidates who are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

  • 5+ years in partner, channel, or alliances sales, with a track record of driving go-to-market across channel, GSI, and hyperscaler partners

  • A bias toward net-new, sourced business, not just tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway

  • Comfort running many partners and many activities in parallel without losing the thread on any of them

  • Experience selling infrastructure, developer platforms, or API/AI technology to enterprise buyers

  • Experience selling open source solutions

  • Experience with B2B sales, deal registration, partner quoting, and co-selling motions

  • Experience with Salesforce and partner management systems (e.g., Partner Portal)

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to remain calm under pressure

  • Established personal network within the industry

  • Results-oriented perspective

  • Interest in Kong and open source software; ability to use Kong

  • Shares Kong's values and works in accordance with them

  • Ability to travel up to 50% and comply with the company's travel policy

For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:
Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers.


What You’ll Do:

  • Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform.

  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production.

  • Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts.

  • Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs.

  • Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements.

  • Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.

  • Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API & AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.

  • Run API & AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures.

  • Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close.

  • Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

  • Drive thought leadership by authoring technical blogs, hosting webinars, speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, API & AI summit, and regional events

  • Influence product direction by synthesizing customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the product team.

  • And any additional tasks required by manager.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company.

  • Proven track record owning complex, enterprise-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent is required.

  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance.

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns.

  • Solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models.

  • Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives.

  • Enthusiasm for working in a high-profile, fast-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:
We are looking for an Engagement Manager to join the growing Professional Services team at Kong. As an Engagement Manager, you will have the opportunity to work across the entire customer lifecycle to drive a prescriptive outcome(s) and successful delivery of engagements and programs for key customers.
The engagement manager will ensure our customers are getting the most value out of Kong products and will help prepare, manage, and deliver strategic engagements across the defined install base. As a primary professional services contact and ambassador for our customers, the engagement manager is a strategic, long-term, relationship-based customer-facing role. Apart from driving successful delivery of services engagements, the Engagement Manager will focus on driving day to day professional services operations.
This is an important role and requires someone with very strong thought organization, and communication skills along with the ability to multitask, context switch, and manage customer escalations. Working at Kong presents a unique opportunity to help customers modernize their approach to IT to embrace Cloud Native development principles.

What You'll Do:

Customer Delivery

  • Own and lead selected, simultaneous billable customer engagements and manage customer expectations and drive prescriptive outcomes during the entire customer lifecycle (Post Sales, Delivery, and Value Realization)

  • Work with customers and stakeholders to understand and analyze engagement scope, requirements, time, cost, benefits, etc. Drive the engagement lifecycle end to end to deliver business outcomes

  • Own and drive project management activities and oversee completion of engagement kickoffs, project charters, and deliverables, managing schedules, meeting milestones, and ensuring success throughout the engagement lifecycle end to end to deliver business outcomes

  • Prepare customer-facing and internal collateral such as solution presentations, blueprints, reusable artifacts, project plans, burndown, and status reports

  • Identify, prioritize, and own resolution of internal and customer escalations & project risks, driving an effective resolution across technical, business, and executive stakeholders

Makes use of productivity tools like FinancialForce, Salesforce, Metabase, Trello, etc. to maintain and manage programs of multiple onboarding and implementation projects along with reporting on key business metrics (Billings, Utilizations, Resource Capacity, and Forecasting)

Professional Services Operations

  • Assist Services leadership team with resource assignment and management in Financial Force

  • Ensure timely completion of Month and Quarter end close process and complete new PS employee onboarding with content tailored to the new hires’ positions

  • Coordinate with cross functional teams to obtain relevant data about the project opportunity and staffing requirements

  • Become a subject matter expert for services personnel on all processes related to services revenue: time entry, project management processes relate to operations, customer billing, and staff utilization

  • Continually provide suggestions and implement improvements to business and reporting processes that keep up with the changes in the organization

  • Support Professional Services staff to better understand revenue, hours, and target attainment goals

  • Excellent customer-facing skills and ability to communicate with executives as well as other stakeholders at customer sites and cross-functionally within Kong. Ability to demonstrate relationship building internally and externally

  • Exceptional organizational and change management skills with an ability to manage competing client demands

  • Excellent presentation skills along with a strong understanding of professional services business metrics in a SaaS software environment. Ability to manage critical and political situations with business stakeholders with strong interpersonal skills

  • Proven team player, and team builder who loves to work in a fast-growing and roll up their sleeves in a dynamic environment and is able to keep pace with constant change

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced sales professional, ideally with open source experience who will be selling into digital natives and commercial accounts. The ideal candidate has been a part of the sales efforts for other early-stage enterprise products in an entrepreneurial setting. The Account Executive will be integral to our growth plan and in acquiring new customers. Kong’s Account Executive will be the primary point of contact and the face of Kong for our prospects.

What You'll Do:
• Sell Kong Konnect Platform on Kong’s Commercial sales team.
• Meet and/or exceed individual quota, objectives and KPIs.
• Take ownership to build and manage your book of business, which includes understanding and documenting the buying criteria and process, determining the appropriate motion and patterns, ensuring pipeline accuracy based on evidence, and working the leads to closure.
• Collaborate and leverage an ecosystem of resources including pre sales, post sales, channel partners, customer success and leadership to promote Kong and drive new business.

What You'll Bring:
• A true desire to see customers benefit from the investment they make with Kong.
• Experience in direct sales experience selling enterprise software to small to mid-size organisations, ideally in APIs, and/or infrastructure software.
• Effective communicator and strong interpersonal skills.
• Excellent negotiation, presentation and closing skills.
• Experience with fast growing startups is a plus.
• Strong background in territory planning and revenue generated from outbound pipeline.
• You have a measurable track record in new business development and over achieving sales targets.
• Knowledge of MEDDIC and Challenger methodologies is a plus.
Preferred:
• A top performer with experience hunting and closing net new logos.
• Experienced with creatively sourcing companies outside of your CRM.
• You have previously worked in an early-stage company and you know how to navigate and be successful in a fast-growing organization.
• Motivated, collaborative, driven and results oriented. (edited)

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box. We're looking for candidates who are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Partner sales is one of Kong's biggest growth engines. The Partner Sales Manager drives revenue through partners: you build joint business plans, grow partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and close business alongside Kong's Account Executives. You own Kong's partner business in your territory across resellers, systems integrators (SIs), and consultancies in AMER. This is a quota-carrying, senior individual contributor role, and you run your territory as your own business with your territory's sales leader.

Partner Sales Manager Responsibilities

  • Be a business advisor to the partners in your territory, and own the number. Drive a joint business plan with each focus partner that sets shared goals for pipeline and revenue, and sell Kong's full portfolio — products, renewals, professional services, and support — through and with them.

  • Partner with Kong Account Executives to increase partner attach. Bring the right partner into live deals, align on target accounts, and make it easy for AEs to win with partners.

  • Orchestrate co-sell, co-marketing, and co-solutioning with each focus partner. You drive the outcomes across all three and coordinate the Kong team — sales engineers, marketing, enablement, and operations — who help you deliver.

  • Sign new partners where there's room to grow, and map your territory to spot new joint opportunities.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline. Set targets, run a steady cadence with each partner, and focus on net-new business.

  • Coordinate deal registration, lead sharing, and co-sell for Kong Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Mesh, and Konnect, and resolve route conflicts fairly.

  • Create joint assets with focus partners, such as reference architectures, blueprints, and solution briefs that field teams on both sides can pick up and use.

  • Run joint marketing events and campaigns that build pipeline.

  • Learn how your partners make money, where Kong fits, and what it takes to win together.

  • Work with Partner Sales Engineers so partners have the technical readiness to sell and deliver Kong.

  • Build strong relationships with Kong Account Sales Managers and geo leadership, and involve sales leadership and support as needed to hit shared targets.

  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews and annual planning for the Partner organization.

  • Share a weekly forecast, and keep partner and opportunity data current in Salesforce and the partner portal.

  • Raise critical business issues early with Partner Sales leadership.

  • Collaborate with Finance, Partner Operations, and Sales Operations, and prepare territory plans, presentations, and reports as needed.

Partner Sales Manager Requirements

  • 5+ years in partner, channel, or alliances sales, with a track record of driving go-to-market through resellers and SIs or consultancies

  • A drive to source net-new business and grow it with partners

  • The organization to run many partners and activities in parallel

  • Experience selling infrastructure, developer platforms, or API and AI technology to enterprise buyers

  • Experience selling open source solutions

  • Experience with B2B sales, deal registration, partner quoting, and co-selling

  • Experience with Salesforce and partner management systems, such as a partner portal

  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong interpersonal skills, and a steady presence under pressure

  • An established network in the industry

  • A results-oriented approach

  • Interest in Kong and open source software, and the ability to use Kong

  • Shares Kong's values and works in accordance with them

  • Ability to travel up to 50% and comply with the company's travel policy

Nice to have:

  • Prior Partner Sales Manager or partner leadership experience at an API, integration, or open-source-led company

  • Hyperscaler co-sell experience, such as AWS ISV Accelerate, Azure IP Co-sell, or GCP Partner Advantage

  • Existing relationships with AMER SIs, regional consultancies, or value-added resellers

  • Sales methodology training, such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box. We're looking for candidates who are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Partner sales is one of Kong's biggest growth engines. The Partner Sales Manager drives revenue through partners: you build joint business plans, grow partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and close business alongside Kong's Account Executives. You own Kong's partner business in your territory across resellers, systems integrators (SIs), and consultancies in AMER. This is a quota-carrying, senior individual contributor role, and you run your territory as your own business with your territory's sales leader.

Partner Sales Manager Responsibilities

  • Be a business advisor to the partners in your territory, and own the number. Drive a joint business plan with each focus partner that sets shared goals for pipeline and revenue, and sell Kong's full portfolio — products, renewals, professional services, and support — through and with them.

  • Partner with Kong Account Executives to increase partner attach. Bring the right partner into live deals, align on target accounts, and make it easy for AEs to win with partners.

  • Orchestrate co-sell, co-marketing, and co-solutioning with each focus partner. You drive the outcomes across all three and coordinate the Kong team — sales engineers, marketing, enablement, and operations — who help you deliver.

  • Sign new partners where there's room to grow, and map your territory to spot new joint opportunities.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline. Set targets, run a steady cadence with each partner, and focus on net-new business.

  • Coordinate deal registration, lead sharing, and co-sell for Kong Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Mesh, and Konnect, and resolve route conflicts fairly.

  • Create joint assets with focus partners, such as reference architectures, blueprints, and solution briefs that field teams on both sides can pick up and use.

  • Run joint marketing events and campaigns that build pipeline.

  • Learn how your partners make money, where Kong fits, and what it takes to win together.

  • Work with Partner Sales Engineers so partners have the technical readiness to sell and deliver Kong.

  • Build strong relationships with Kong Account Sales Managers and geo leadership, and involve sales leadership and support as needed to hit shared targets.

  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews and annual planning for the Partner organization.

  • Share a weekly forecast, and keep partner and opportunity data current in Salesforce and the partner portal.

  • Raise critical business issues early with Partner Sales leadership.

  • Collaborate with Finance, Partner Operations, and Sales Operations, and prepare territory plans, presentations, and reports as needed.

Partner Sales Manager Requirements

  • 5+ years in partner, channel, or alliances sales, with a track record of driving go-to-market through resellers and SIs or consultancies

  • A drive to source net-new business and grow it with partners

  • The organization to run many partners and activities in parallel

  • Experience selling infrastructure, developer platforms, or API and AI technology to enterprise buyers

  • Experience selling open source solutions

  • Experience with B2B sales, deal registration, partner quoting, and co-selling

  • Experience with Salesforce and partner management systems, such as a partner portal

  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong interpersonal skills, and a steady presence under pressure

  • An established network in the industry

  • A results-oriented approach

  • Interest in Kong and open source software, and the ability to use Kong

  • Shares Kong's values and works in accordance with them

  • Ability to travel up to 50% and comply with the company's travel policy

Nice to have:

  • Prior Partner Sales Manager or partner leadership experience at an API, integration, or open-source-led company

  • Hyperscaler co-sell experience, such as AWS ISV Accelerate, Azure IP Co-sell, or GCP Partner Advantage

  • Existing relationships with AMER SIs, regional consultancies, or value-added resellers

  • Sales methodology training, such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message

For more information, visit www.konghq.com.
